**About Us**
Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.
  
  
Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.
  
  
2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to
**$200M+ in ARR**
, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.
  
  
We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.
  
  
Joining Legora means three things.
  
  

* We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
* We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
* We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.
  
  
If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.
  
  
****About The Role****
The way legal work gets done is changing, and Engagement is at the center of that transformation. We're looking for an experienced, strategic Engagement Manager to join our growing team and help a large portfolio of law firms and corporate legal teams fundamentally change the way they work with Legora.
  
  
This is a role for someone who has managed a high-volume portfolio through a one-to-many model, and who knows that transformation across a large portfolio of clients has to be designed, automated and measured. You will drive adoption, technical health and commercial outcomes of your portfolio end-to-end by leveraging systems and technology while reserving high-touch interactions for the most impactful moments.
  
  
You will be critical as we continue to build a best-in-class adoption program at Legora, helping clients realize measurable ROI, expand successful use cases and transform the way their teams work.
  
  
****What You'll Do****
You'll own the post-sale motion end-to-end for a large portfolio of law firms and corporate legal teams across our EMEA scaled portfolio. Specifically, you will:
  
  

* Improve the one-to-many adoption playbook: the tech-led onboarding, enablement, and change-management motions and target outcomes for how our scaled customers adopt Legora and transform the way they work.
* Execute against that playbook, sequencing automated touchpoints and interventions from initial rollout to firm-wide adoption, and adapting as the client's needs and Legora's capabilities evolve.
* Facilitate strategic touchpoints with your highest stakes accounts, while using one-to-many enablement to surface high-impact opportunities and guide the rest of the portfolio toward maximum value from Legora.
* Drive sustained value through a programmatic operating cadence: templated success plans, one-to-many enablement, scaled training and digital value reviews.
* Manage the health of the portfolio by monitoring adoption and utilization signals in our internal systems to proactively flag and act on risks and growth opportunities.
* Own the commercials for the scaled program end-to-end by running renewal and expansion as repeatable motions informed by exquisite portfolio hygiene, forecasting, and data utilization.
* Orchestrate engagement across cross-functional teams (Product, Legal Engineering, Engineering, Product Marketing, Support) to accelerate client success, maintaining end-to-end portfolio context and coordination.
* Translate scaled customer feedback into action by collaborating closely with Product, Engineering, and Product Marketing to inform roadmap, positioning, and enablement, and to represent the voice of the scaled segment.

****What We Offer:****
You care deeply about customer outcomes and you know that transformation at scale has to be designed, automated and measured. You're proactive, systems-minded and comfortable making tradeoffs about where to intervene and where to let technology do the work. You take pride in being the reason customers adopt, grow and succeed.
  
  
**We're Looking For:**

* A scaled customer success, renewal management, or customer education background, with a demonstrated track record of designing and delivering programs that serve large customer bases through a one-to-many model.
* Experience building repeatable adoption playbooks and educational programs and delivering them at scale across digital channels.
* 3+ years for Manager, 5+ years for Senior Manager, in scaled or digital customer success, customer operations, account management, or a related field, ideally with exposure to high-growth B2B AI verticals or Legal Tech. Leveling will depend on specific experience and fit for the segment.
* A track record of driving adoption, retention and expansion with a high-volume portfolio of clients, without individual coverage of every account.
* Ownership of a commercial number: you have carried GRR and NRR for a portfolio and run renewal and expansion yourself as repeatable motions, hitting the thresholds by leveraging data and automation.
* Technical fluency and systems thinking: you're comfortable configuring and deploying tooling (CS and CRM platforms, AI agents, LMS, data visualization platforms) to deliver outcomes.
* Data fluency and a metrics-driven approach to customer health, forecasting and portfolio strategy at scale.
* Exceptional program, project and prioritization skills; you keep many clients and multi-workstream initiatives moving concurrently.
* Excellent Arabic and English communication skills — written, verbal, and interpersonal.
* High EQ: you know when to listen, when to advise and when to act.
* A love of fast-paced, early-stage environments where you help build the playbook, not just follow it.

****What We Offer:****

* The opportunity to join and grow within Legora’s SMB post-sale engagement team in EMEA.
* A role with real ownership of customer outcomes and visibility across product, go-to-market, and support functions.
* Collaboration with leadership and cross-functional teams to build systems that shape customer outcomes.
* A fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment where excellence is rewarded, and growth is exponential.
* Competitive compensation, meaningful equity participation, and an office designed for focus and high performance.

**Job Purpose:**

The Restaurant Technology Manager – UAE is the single point of accountability for all restaurant technology across the UAE market, reporting directly to the Global Head of Technology Operations. The role leads the delivery, support and continuous improvement of all in-store and guest-facing technology across brands, including POS/MIS, BSP, Digital, ALMP, Kiosk, Digital Menu Boards, Drive-Thru, Last Mile and Aggregator integrations, as well as store networks, Wi-Fi, payment terminals, CCTV and peripherals. The role also manages the restaurant technology vendor portfolio end to end, including contracts, SLAs, service reviews, billing and invoice validation, and payment tracking with Finance and Procurement. By maximizing restaurant uptime, enabling fast incident resolution and ensuring accurate, cost-effective technology spend, the role protects restaurant sales and guest experience while supporting growth and digital ambitions.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Restaurant Technology Ownership:**
  Own the end-to-end management of all restaurant technology components in the UAE – POS / MIS, BSP, Digital ordering, ALMP, Kiosk, DMB, Drive-Thru, Last Mile and Aggregator integrations, store network / Wi-Fi, payment terminals, CCTV and peripherals – ensuring stable, secure and standardised operation across all brands.
* **Service Operations & Incident Management:**
  Lead the UAE restaurant technology support team; define, implement and continually improve incident, problem, request and change management processes in line with ITIL and ATO standards.
* **Escalation & Major Incident Management:**
  Act as the escalation point for UAE restaurant operations both in and out of hours; lead major incidents, stakeholder communication and root cause analysis (RCA).
* **Vendor Management:**
  Manage all UAE restaurant technology vendors and service providers (POS / hardware, kiosk, DMB, drive-thru, network / telecom, payment, aggregator integration, field service): onboarding, SOWs, SLA governance, monthly service reviews, vendor scorecards, penalties / service credits and renewals, in coordination with Procurement and Legal.
* **Vendor Billing & Invoice Validation:**
  Validate every vendor invoice before approval against contract rates, POs, SOWs, asset / license / site counts, delivered services, GRNs and SLA performance; identify and recover over-billing, duplicate charges and unapplied credits.
* **Vendor Payment Validation & Tracking:**
  Validate and track vendor payments with Finance / Accounts Payable; maintain the vendor payment and accruals tracker, ensure payments are released on time and only for accepted deliverables, and resolve vendor payment disputes.
* **Budget & Cost Management:**
  Prepare and manage the UAE restaurant technology opex and capex budget; track actuals vs budget and forecast; drive cost optimisation across licenses, maintenance contracts, telecom and hardware.
* **New Store Openings, Remodels & Rollouts:**
  Deliver restaurant technology for new store openings, remodels, relocations and closures, and lead UAE rollouts of new technology (kiosk, DMB, drive-thru, digital) on time, on budget and to standard.
* **Asset & License Management:**
  Maintain an accurate register of restaurant hardware, software licenses and spares; plan lifecycle refresh and manage the spares pool.
* **Information Security & Compliance:**
  Ensure restaurant technology complies with Americana IT security policies, PCI-DSS for card payments and UAE regulatory requirements, including patching, endpoint protection and access control.
* **Stakeholder Management & Reporting:**
  Partner with UAE Operations, Brands, Marketing, Digital, Finance and Procurement; provide monthly service, vendor and spend performance reporting to the Global Head of Technology Operations; keep SOPs, KEDB, network diagrams and the vendor contract register up to date.
* **People Leadership:**
  Lead, coach and develop the team; set objectives, run mid-year and annual reviews, build individual development and succession plans, and manage shift and on-call rosters.
* **Other Duties:**
  Undertake other duties as assigned by the Global Head of Technology Operations.

**Qualification: -**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering or a closely related field.
* Master’s degree / MBA is preferred.
* ITIL v4 Foundation (or higher) certification required; PMP / PRINCE2 preferred.

**Experience: -**

* 10+ years of IT experience, including at least 5 years in a managerial role in restaurant, QSR, hospitality or retail technology.
* Excellent knowledge of restaurant technology systems and infrastructure – POS (NCR / Oracle an advantage), kiosk, DMB, drive-thru, digital ordering, loyalty and aggregator integrations.
* Must have delivered and supported solutions for an estate of 150+ stores; UAE / GCC experience strongly preferred.
* Proven vendor management experience, including contract and SLA management, vendor billing / invoice validation and payment reconciliation.
* Experience owning an IT opex / capex budget and reporting actuals vs budget.
* Has been through or led significant change within a restaurant or retail technology environment.

**Job Specific Skills:**

* ITIL service management – incident, problem, change and request management.
* Strong vendor and contract management, negotiation and commercial acumen.
* Invoice, billing and payment validation; financial controls, accruals and reconciliation.
* Working knowledge of retail networks, payment security (PCI-DSS) and endpoint management.
* ITSM tools (e.g. ServiceNow) and reporting / analytics (Excel, Power BI)
* Project and rollout management for multi-site deployments.

**Major Challenges:**

* 24/7 restaurant operations with late-night and delivery trading; on-call and out-of-hours escalations are part of the role.
* Large multi-brand estate across all Emirates with differing technology stacks, channels (dine-in, drive-thru, kiosk, delivery, aggregators) and brand requirements.
* Managing many vendors with different SLAs, contract and billing models; ensuring every invoice reflects contracted rates and delivered service, and resolving billing and payment disputes without disrupting restaurant service.
* Balancing cost control and budget discipline with restaurant uptime and guest experience; dependencies on third-party platforms (aggregators, payment providers, telecom) outside direct control.
* Fast new-store and rollout pipeline with tight, fixed opening dates.
* Frequent travel to restaurants across the UAE.

**Leadership Traits:**

* Business Succession Planning
* Business Acumen
* Entrepreneurship
* Budgets and Financial Reports
* Crisis Management

We are currently recruiting for a
**Senior Manager - Planning and Operations**
to join our Transport Team in our HQ, located in DAFZA, Dubai Airport Free Zone.

**Scope:**

Senior Manager-Planning and Operations is accountable for the end-to-end planning, optimisation, delivery and performance of Transguard’s workforce transportation network. The role owns the integrated transport planning and operational delivery cycle, ensuring transport demand forecasts are translated into effective fleet, driver and route plans and successfully executed through operational teams. The position is responsible for maximizing the utilization, efficiency and performance of a transport network comprising approximately 700 vehicles supporting more than 45,000 daily passenger movements. This includes accountability for fleet deployment, driver utilisation, route optimisation, service delivery, customer performance, transport costs and operational productivity. The role leads planning analysts, transport supervisors and operational teams to ensure alignment between workforce demand, transport capacity and customer requirements. Through the use of AI-enabled planning tools, transport management systems, telematics, GPS technology and business intelligence platforms, the role establishes a closed-loop performance management process that continuously measures actual performance against planned outcomes, drives operational improvements, improves planning accuracy and delivers sustainable efficiency gains across the transport function.

**Responsibilities:**

**Financial**

* Accountable for the optimization and performance of a transport operation with an annual operating budget.
* Own fleet utilization, resource allocation and service efficiency to maximise value from transport assets and workforce resources.
* Drive route optimization, vehicle productivity and driver utilisation initiatives to reduce operating costs whilst maintaining agreed service levels.
* Lead the identification and delivery of cost reduction, cost avoidance and operational efficiency opportunities across the transport network.
* Establish performance measures and reporting frameworks to monitor transport costs, utilization, productivity and return on fleet investment.

**Customer**

* Accountable for the delivery of safe, reliable and efficient transportation services supporting more than 45,000 daily passenger movements across Transguard operations.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders and external clients to ensure transport services align with operational requirements, workforce deployment plans and contractual commitments.
* Establish customer service standards, performance metrics and service level agreements, ensuring transport performance consistently meets agreed expectations.
* Lead the resolution of service issues, operational escalations and customer concerns, implementing corrective actions to improve service reliability and customer satisfaction.
* Utilize customer feedback, operational performance data and service reviews to identify improvement opportunities and enhance the overall customer experience.
* Provide regular performance reporting and operational insights to business leaders, creating transparency and confidence in transport service delivery.

**Process**

* Accountable for the end-to-end transport planning and operational delivery model across all workforce transportation activities.
* Own the integrated planning cycle, ensuring transport demand forecasts are translated into executable vehicle, route and driver deployment plans.
* Lead planning, scheduling and operational delivery teams to ensure transport services are delivered in accordance with business requirements and customer commitments.
* Establish and govern planning standards, operating procedures and performance frameworks across transport operations.
* Accountable for fleet utilization, route efficiency, driver productivity and service performance across the transport network.
* Direct the deployment of vehicles, drivers and operational resources to maximize service reliability and operational efficiency.
* Establish structured performance reviews comparing planned versus actual outcomes and ensure corrective actions are implemented to address variances.
* Lead transport capacity planning, network design and resource planning activities to support future business growth and changing demand.
* Own business continuity, operational resilience and transport risk management frameworks.
* Develop governance processes that create continuous improvement between planning assumptions, operational outcomes and future transport plans.

**Innovation**

* Support the transport planning and delivery transformation roadmap through the adoption of AI-enabled planning, predictive analytics, automation and optimization technologies.
* Establish a data-driven transport operating model using telematics, GPS intelligence and business intelligence platforms.
* Develop automated performance reporting that provides visibility of utilization, productivity, operational efficiency and customer service outcomes.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance planning accuracy, improve operational performance and optimize asset utilization.
* Identify emerging transport technologies and support the development of business cases that improve efficiency, sustainability and customer experience.
* Create a culture of continuous learning and operational excellence by embedding performance feedback loops between planning and delivery teams.

**Selection Criteria:**

* Minimum 8-10 years' experience in large-scale transport, logistics, fleet or workforce mobility operations.
* Proven experience leading both transport planning and operational delivery functions within a complex, high-volume operational environment.
* Demonstrated experience managing transport management systems, telematics platforms, GPS technologies and business intelligence solutions.
* Strong track record in fleet optimization, route scheduling, capacity planning and operational productivity improvement.
* Experience leading large multidisciplinary teams and delivering measurable operational performance improvements.
* Strong analytical, commercial and data-driven decision-making capability.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel, Power BI and transport planning software.

**On call bench, self employed, paid per engagement. Sharjah, United Arab Emirates, on site.**

**How this role works**

This is an On call bench role, not a job. You work on a self employed basis, through your own company or as a sole trader, and you stay free to keep your current work or practice. Unlike the rest of the bench, this role is tied to a place: you hold the keys to our forensic laboratory in Sharjah, so you are paid for two upkeep days each month as well as for the work on each case. There is no salary and no guaranteed caseload, and the amount of case work will vary from month to month.

Outbreach is a specialist cyber incident response and crisis management firm working with mid market organisations in the UK and the Gulf. We bring together incident management, digital forensics, legal, crisis communications and recovery under one roof so that a client in the middle of a breach has one partner rather than five.

We are opening a small digital forensics laboratory in Sharjah, alongside a second in Epsom, Surrey. Client laptops, drives and phones come to the lab under chain of custody and are imaged there, and our investigators then analyse the images on secure cloud desktops. We are looking for a Forensic Laboratory Manager to run the lab: the person who books evidence in and out, keeps it secure, takes the forensic images, and keeps the lab and its records in a state a court or an auditor could inspect at any time.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Receive client devices, photograph and seal them, give each an exhibit number and record it in our case management system.
* Hold the keys, the safe and the custody record, and be the person who can say where every exhibit has been and who handled it.
* Image computers, drives, memory cards and phones through write blockers and forensic imagers, verify the hashes, and upload the images securely to our evidence storage.
* Carry out logical data recovery from deleted, formatted or damaged media where a case needs it, and prepare failed drives for our specialist recovery partner.
* Return or destroy devices at the end of a matter, with a certificate.
* Validate the lab's tools and hardware against our reference data, keep the validation records, and maintain the lab's desktop image.
* Look after the room, the safe, access control, CCTV and consumables, and keep the lab ready for audit.
* Get to the lab at short notice when urgent evidence arrives, and agree cover for leave with a named bench investigator.

**Skills and Experience**

* Evidence Handling (Essential): you have acquired evidence from computers, drives or phones yourself, using write blockers or a forensic imager, and kept the chain of custody record for it, in a forensic laboratory, a police or law enforcement digital forensics unit, or a forensic consultancy.
* Forensic Tooling: hands on with Tableau or similar hardware and with imaging and verification tools such as FTK Imager, ewfacquire or X-Ways. Phone extraction with MSAB XRY, Cellebrite or similar is a strong advantage.
* Process and Records: you keep accurate records without being chased and are comfortable working to written procedures of the kind ISO/IEC 17025 expects.
* Cyber Security: cyber security experience is required for this role, gained working in or alongside cyber security or incident response.
* Location (Essential): you live in Sharjah, Ajman or northern Dubai and can get to the lab at short notice.
* You must be living in the UAE and able to contract with us from there. We do not offer visa sponsorship.
* You will be background checked before you hold keys to the lab.

**Highly Desirable (But Not Essential)**

* GCFE, GCFA, CFCE, EnCE or MSAB certification, or equivalent.
* Experience of ISO/IEC 17025 accreditation or a Forensic Science Regulator audit.
* Experience of data recovery from damaged or failing media.

If your experience is SOC monitoring, IT support, or data recovery without evidential handling, rather than forensic acquisition under chain of custody, this is not the right role.

Bench members are not employees. You invoice Outbreach for the upkeep days and for the work on each case, you look after your own tax and insurance, and there is no minimum caseload. You can decline any case engagement; custody duties at the lab are covered by the named bench investigator when you are away.

**Group Operational Asset Lifecycle Manager**

We are a leading independent telecoms infrastructure company, with one of the most extensive tower portfolios across Africa and the Middle East. Our business model promotes tower infrastructure sharing and enables mobile network operators (MNOs) to deliver mobile connectivity more quickly, reliably, cost-effectively and with a lower carbon footprint. In turn, this supports the expansion and quality of mobile connectivity, driving sustainable development in our markets.

**What we do**

We build, acquire, lease-up and operate telecommunications towers that can accommodate and power the needs of multiple tenants. Our tenants are major mobile network operators (MNOs), and we serve them across nine high-growth markets: eight in Africa and Oman in the Middle East. Our purpose, mission and sustainable business strategy are underpinned by our values of integrity, partnership and excellence.

**Overview**

Reporting into the Operations & Performance Engineering function, you will develop, govern and improve Group operational asset lifecycle strategies for telecommunications infrastructure assets. You will help ensure strong operational performance, reliability, safety, QHSE compliance and long-term value across the asset portfolio.

Working with Engineering, Operations, Finance, Procurement, IT and Maintenance Partners, you will lead lifecycle planning, asset performance optimisation, change governance, capital investment planning and asset information management. You will use data-led decision-making and digital asset management to improve lifecycle costs, governance and engineering standards across the Group.

**Location:**
UAE or South Africa
  
**Travel:**
Approximately 6–12 times per year

**Role responsibilities**

As Group Operational Asset Lifecycle Manager, you will be responsible for:

* Developing Group lifecycle and governance strategies for power systems, shelters and associated infrastructure.
* Preparing and implementing long-term asset replacement, refurbishment and renewal plans.
* Establishing and governing asset refurbishment programmes across operating companies.
* Improving preventive, predictive and condition-based maintenance strategies to strengthen reliability and extend asset life.
* Optimising total cost of ownership, return on invested capital and asset utilisation through effective lifecycle investment decisions.
* Owning the Group Asset Change Governance process for engineering modifications, integrations, transfers, refurbishments, relocations and disposals.
* Establishing and improving the Group Asset Governance Framework, including asset ownership, approval authorities, engineering acceptance and retirement controls.
* Developing the annual maintenance CAPEX investment programme and prioritising work according to asset condition, criticality and operational risk.
* Monitoring and reporting asset health, reliability, utilisation and effectiveness, using analytics to identify improvement opportunities.
* Governing asset information standards and data quality across Group systems, including asset master data, serialisation, configuration records and technical documentation.

**Requirements for the role**

To succeed in the role, you will have:

* A degree in Engineering, Business, Asset Management or a related technical discipline.
* 7–10 years’ experience in telecommunications infrastructure or another asset-intensive industry.

To help us maintain our high standards of service, we are seeking an experienced and accomplished Logistics Supervisor, to drive both innovation and execution in our busy Transportation network.

Key job responsibilities  
As a Senior Solutions Architect, you will own the technical relationship with customers end-to-end. This means:  
  

* Partnering with enterprise customers across multiple industries to understand their business objectives, assess their current technology landscape, and architect cloud solutions that deliver real outcomes in cost optimization, operational efficiency, security, reliability, and innovation.

  

* Translating industry-specific challenges into AWS architectures. Examples include modernizing core banking and payments platforms while meeting regulatory and data residency requirements; building omnichannel commerce, personalization, and supply chain solutions for retailers.

Dubai, UAE

  
  

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Lead Tunnel Geotechnical Engineer** to join our team! In this role you will take technical ownership of the **geotechnical and tunnelling engineering** of the Airport Express Line and other high-profile rail, bridge and marine programmes — leading the design of **large-diameter TBM tunnels, mined crossover caverns and deep station excavations**, setting the ground investigation strategy that underpins them, and playing your part in the development of the City's infrastructure for the 21st Century.

  

**What You'll Be Doing:**

  
  

***Tunnel and Geotechnical Design Leadership:***

* Leading the geotechnical design of large-diameter (D > 10 m) TBM tunnels, including the TBM crossover caverns at rail junctions — ground treatment and pre-support, temporary and permanent support design, and excavation sequencing (SEM/NATM) of cavern and enlargement works.
* Leading deep excavation (> 30 m) methodology studies for stations, shafts and cross-passages — comparison and selection of retention systems (diaphragm wall, secant pile, top-down), base stability, dewatering and groundwater control, and the resulting construction methodology.
* Directing building and utility damage assessment for third-party structures adjacent to the alignment — volume loss and settlement prediction, Stage 1 to Stage 3 damage risk assessment, protective and mitigation measures, and instrumentation & monitoring with trigger levels and response plans.
* Predicting advance and production rates for large-diameter TBM drives, and forecasting cutter intervention frequency and location — including hyperbaric versus atmospheric intervention strategy, ground treatment at intervention points, and the effect of abrasivity, mixed-face and boulder conditions on the programme.
Owning the numerical modelling strategy (2D/3D finite element and finite difference — PLAXIS, FLAC/FLAC3D, MIDAS GTS or equivalent), soil-structure interaction, groundwater and seismic assessment, and technically reviewing the team's analyses.  

***Ground Investigation and Geotechnical Reporting:***

* Collecting, reviewing and interpreting existing and historical ground investigation data from adjacent and previous projects, and producing the project Geotechnical Interpretative Report (GIR), the geotechnical design parameters and, where required, the Geotechnical Baseline Report (GBR).
* Defining the ground investigation requirements for new projects — scope, technical specification, borehole layout and depths, in-situ and advanced laboratory testing schedules and geophysical surveys — and preparing the associated tender documents and technical evaluation.
* Managing the ground investigation programme from procurement to close-out: supervision of the GI contractor, factual report review, schedule and budget control, and timely integration of the results into the design.
  

  

***TBM Operations and Constructability:***

* Carrying out and documenting TBM optioning studies — machine type (EPB / slurry / variable density / hybrid), diameter, cutterhead and cutting tool configuration, back-up arrangement and segmental lining — with a clear and auditable basis of selection.
* Developing the TBM procurement and manufacturing plan (technical specification, manufacturing and factory acceptance programme, delivery and assembly schedule) together with the segment casting yard and site establishment plan.
* Preparing and documenting tunnelling logistics plans — launch and reception shafts, muck haulage and disposal, slurry treatment and separation plant, segment supply, annulus grouting, ventilation, power and water supply — and issuing them as method statements, technical notes and design reports.
  

  

***Team, Resource and Sub-Consultant Management:***

* Managing and directing the work of the existing geotechnical and tunnelling staff — workload planning, task allocation, technical direction, quality checking prior to submission, and mentoring.
* Supporting the Director and Technical Director in strengthening the team — identifying resource gaps, defining roles, interviewing and recruiting new staff.
* Selecting, scoping and contracting specialist sub-consultants and third-party service providers (ground investigation contractors, numerical analysis specialists, instrumentation and monitoring providers), and managing their technical and commercial delivery.

  

**What Required Skills You'll Bring:**

* Bachelor's degree in Civil or Geotechnical Engineering; an MSc or PhD in Geotechnical or Tunnelling Engineering is strongly preferred.
* Minimum 20 years' relevant post-graduate work experience in geotechnical and tunnel engineering, of which at least 3 years must be on large-diameter TBM rail or metro tunnelling projects in a lead or principal role, is mandatory.
* Demonstrable, project-specific experience in each of the following: large-diameter (D > 10 m) TBM tunnel design; mined crossover cavern and junction design; deep (> 30 m) excavation and shaft design; third-party building damage assessment; and TBM production rate and cutter intervention prediction.
* Proven authorship of Geotechnical Interpretative Reports (GIR) and ground investigation specifications, and hands-on management of GI campaigns from scoping through to design integration.
* A recognised technical authority in tunnelling geotechnics — the depth of specialisation typically developed within a dedicated tunnelling and geotechnical consultancy, rather than a generalist civil engineering background.

* Advanced user of geotechnical numerical analysis software (PLAXIS 2D/3D, FLAC/FLAC3D, MIDAS GTS or equivalent).
* Prior experience providing guidance and leadership to junior engineers and managing sub-consultants.
* Strong communication skills, written and oral, in English.
* Dedication to technical excellence, innovation, and high-quality delivery.

  
  

**What Desired Skills You'll Bring:**

* Experience gained with a specialist tunnelling / geotechnical consultancy on major metro, high-speed rail or road tunnel programmes.

* Experience working in an ISO 19650 BIM-compliant environment and software in a Common Data Environment.

Technical Skills & Tools

* Approve voids, refunds and discounts within agreed limits.
* Run daily spot counts on high-value items (coffee, milk, dairy alternatives, pastries) and the weekly full stock count.
* Log all waste and place supplier orders against par levels.
* Receive deliveries and check quantity, quality and temperature against the invoice.

Food safety and hygiene

* Enforce Dubai Municipality food safety rules and the cafe's HACCP-based food safety plan.
* Complete temperature logs for fridges, freezers and deliveries every shift.
* Make sure every food handler holds a valid Dubai Municipality occupational health card and required food safety training.
* Enforce cleaning schedules, allergen controls, labelling and FIFO stock rotation.

Customer service

* Set and model Escena's service standards on the floor.
* Handle complaints on the spot and log any that need follow-up.
* Monitor online reviews and delivery-app ratings with the Cafe Manager.

## \*1. Job Purpose\*

### \*A. Air Conditioning (AC) & HVAC Maintenance\*

1. Perform regular inspection and preventive maintenance of all split AC, package AC, central AC and HVAC systems.

2. Clean and replace AC filters as per the maintenance schedule.

3. Clean evaporator and condenser coils.

4. Inspect and clean AC drainage lines and drain trays to prevent water leakage.

5. Check refrigerant gas pressure and identify refrigerant leakage.

6. Inspect compressors, thermostats, fan motors and control systems.

7. Check AC cooling performance and maintain the required temperature.

8. Troubleshoot AC breakdowns, cooling problems and abnormal noise.

9. Inspect ducting, insulation, air diffusers and ventilation systems.

10. Monitor AC electricity consumption and report abnormal readings.

11. Coordinate with specialist AC contractors for major repairs and gas charging when required.

12. Maintain AC maintenance records for all branches.

### \*B. Electrical Maintenance\*

1. Inspect and maintain electrical distribution boards (DBs).

2. Repair electrical wiring, switches, sockets and lighting.

3. Troubleshoot electrical faults and power failures.

4. Inspect circuit breakers, isolators and electrical protection systems.

5. Support PAT testing and electrical safety inspections.

6. Monitor electrical load distribution.

7. Report electrical hazards and abnormalities.

### \*C. Mechanical & Kitchen Equipment Maintenance\*

1. Maintain commercial kitchen equipment.

2. Inspect refrigerators, freezers, chillers and cooling equipment.

3. Maintain pumps, motors and exhaust fans.

4. Inspect ventilation and fresh-air systems.

5. Troubleshoot mechanical breakdowns.

6. Coordinate specialist equipment repairs when required.

### \*D. Plumbing Maintenance\*

1. Repair water leakage and damaged pipes.

2. Maintain water pumps, valves and water supply systems.

3. Repair taps, sinks and washbasins.

4. Inspect drainage systems and clear blockages.

2. Attend maintenance complaints from all branches.

5. Identify recurring equipment problems.

6. Maintain records of maintenance activities.

1. Follow company HSE policies and UAE safety requirements.

2. Use appropriate PPE.

3. Follow Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures.

4. Obtain Permit to Work (PTW) before controlled maintenance activities.

JOB SUMMARY

The Project Manager holds single-point accountability for the delivery of large-scale building projects valued at AED 150 million or more, from contract award through to handover, defects liability and final account. The Project Manager owns the contract, the programme, the project budget and the client relationship, directs the Construction Manager and the full project team, and represents the company to the client, engineer and project management consultant (PMC).

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Contract & Commercial Management

* Administer the main contract (FIDIC-based) on behalf of the company: contractual notices, variations, extensions of time (EOT), prolongation and disruption claims, and all formal correspondence with the engineer and client.

* Set the subcontract and procurement strategy, lead package awards with back-to-back terms, and hold subcontractors to contract on programme, quality and payment.

* Lead the final account, settlement of subcontractor accounts, and release of retention and bonds.

2. Programme & Project Controls

* Own the resource-loaded baseline programme (Primavera P6), its approval by the engineer and its monthly update, and defend it in delay analysis.

* Maintain the project risk register with owners and mitigation, and report early warnings before slippage becomes delay.

* Run the monthly project review with senior management covering progress, cost, cash, risk, quality and safety, with recovery plans where required.

* Secure long-lead procurement and Abu Dhabi authority approvals and NOCs (municipality, civil defence, utilities) on the critical path ahead of site need.

3. Client & Stakeholder Management

* Act as the company's representative to the client, engineer, PMC and authorities, with authority to sign project correspondence.

* Chair client progress meetings, manage escalations and negotiate resolutions on commercial, technical and programme matters.

* Be accountable for client satisfaction and for positioning the company for repeat work with the client and consultant.

* Oversee the submittal and approvals process (materials, shop drawings, method statements, prequalifications) so that approvals do not delay the site.

4. Delivery Oversight

* Direct the Construction Manager and, through them, the site team; agree delivery targets against the approved programme and review performance monthly.

* Approve the construction execution plan, staffing plan and site organisation, and adjust resources to protect the critical path.

* Resolve escalated design, coordination and cross-discipline issues with the engineer and client, and oversee the RFI and technical query process.

* Be accountable for the project quality plan and inspection and test plans, and ensure non-conformances are closed out promptly and rejections are not repeated.

* Ensure Estidama (Pearl Rating) and other sustainability requirements are delivered as part of the programme and close-out.

* Oversee testing and commissioning, snagging and handover, and secure the taking-over certificate and defects liability period close-out.

6. Leadership & Development

* Build, lead and develop the project team including the Construction Manager, site engineers, planners, quantity surveyors, QA/QC and HSE staff.

* Set objectives, monitor performance and mentor staff to strengthen technical, commercial and managerial capability.

* Maintain high standards of professional conduct and integrity.

QUALIFICATIONS

* Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or Construction Management (Master's degree preferred).

* Minimum 15 years in building construction with a main contractor, including at least 5 years as Project Manager with full accountability for programme, cost and contract on projects of AED 150 million or more in the UAE.

* Track record of delivery for major UAE developers or government clients under consultant-driven submittal and inspection regimes.

* Strong knowledge of FIDIC contracts, contract administration, EOT and claims, and UAE construction regulations including authority approvals and Estidama requirements.

* Commercial control: cost reporting, cash flow forecasting, margin management and subcontract management.

* Proficiency in Primavera P6, document management platforms (Asite / Aconex) and MS Office.

* Excellent leadership, negotiation, communication and decision-making skills, with the ability to deliver under pressure and tight deadlines.

* PMP, MCIOB or Chartered Engineer status (preferred).

* Membership of the UAE Society of Engineers, or eligibility to register (preferred).

* Fluent in English; Arabic is an advantage.

****About the Role****
The Technical Lead owns end-to-end delivery across the organization's modern and legacy enterprise technology stacks. The role is accountable for functional delivery and equally for non-functional requirements (NFRs): performance, scalability, availability, observability, security and maintainability. You will keep business-critical systems stable and secure, lead their evolution to modern architecture, and ensure every solution aligns with enterprise architecture standards set by the Technology Architecture Group (TAG).
  
  
**Your Duties Would Include**
**Technical leadership**

* Define architecture, standards and patterns for front end, back end, data and integrations across both stacks.
* Lead the modernization roadmap, such as legacy web frameworks to modern SPA frameworks, .NET Framework to modern .NET, and monolith to microservices. Use incremental approaches and plan for coexistence.
* Make build, buy, refactor or retire decisions, and track technical debt.
* Run design reviews, spikes and proofs of concept. Turn requirements into architecture plans, estimates and task breakdowns.

**Non-functional Requirements (NFR) Ownership**

* Elicit, define, prioritize and document NFRs with stakeholders at the start of every initiative: performance, scalability, availability/SLA, resilience, capacity, security, observability, supportability and compliance.
* Convert NFRs into measurable targets (SLOs, response-time and throughput thresholds) and acceptance criteria, and design for them from the start.
* Verify NFRs before release through load, stress, soak and resilience testing, and sign off against agreed targets.
* Own capacity planning, caching, query and API optimization, and bottleneck analysis.
* Track NFR debt and include it in backlog prioritization.

**Observability and performance engineering**

* Implement and govern monitoring, logging, tracing and APM using enterprise tooling (ELK stack, Dynatrace, Azure Application Insights).
* Define standard logging, correlation ID, health-check, alerting and dashboard practices across services.

* Plan and run load and performance testing (for example JMeter, k6, Azure Load Testing, or equivalent) and report results with recommendations.

**DevSecOps and security**

* Embed security into the pipeline: static analysis (SonarQube), software composition and dependency scanning (Nexus IQ / Sonatype), and GitHub Advanced Security (code scanning, secret scanning, Dependabot).
* Own the remediation lifecycle for findings, with prioritization, ownership and SLA-based closure. Prevent quality-gate bypass.
* Coordinate with IT Security on VAPT (vulnerability assessment and penetration testing): scope, environment readiness, fix and retest, and closure evidence.
* Apply OWASP, secure coding, secrets management and hardening practices. Apply OAuth2/OIDC, JWT and role-based access, including bridging legacy authentication to modern identity.
* Keep dependencies, packages and runtime versions current, and retire unsupported components.

**Enterprise architecture alignment**

* Align solution designs with TAG principles, reference architectures, approved technology standards and governance checkpoints.
* Prepare and present design documentation for architecture review, and secure approvals and exceptions where deviations are needed.
* Ensure reuse of shared frameworks, libraries and patterns, and avoid technology sprawl.

* Coach FLS engineers and support Saudization and competence development.

Women’s College Hospital (WCH) is seeking a dynamic, inspiring and visionary medical leader to lead the Department of Medicine and join the medical leadership team. The Department Head will advance innovative models of specialized ambulatory care and strengthen academic, interprofessional, and interorganizational collaboration to improve access, quality and health outcomes for women and gender-diverse people.

Liteline Corporation is a privately held Canadian commercial lighting manufacturer with more than 160 employees, selling across Canada and the United States. We are adding a Director of Business Technology to our leadership team, a senior, hands-on role with ownership of technology across the business.

The role has two halves. The first is the job every growing company needs: keep our technology running, secure and recoverable across roughly 130 computers, Microsoft 365, our server cluster and our network. The second is newer. Our own people, from the three Co-Presidents to staff in Finance, Product Development, Engineering and Customer Service, now build software tools with AI assistants. The Director of Business Technology will give that work a professional backbone: version control, permissions, backups and fast recovery.

This is an enabling role as much as a technical one. We want our people to keep building quickly. The person in this position will make sure what they build is safe, recoverable and well looked after, without slowing anyone down.

This is a build role. Liteline’s people are already creating their own tools with AI. We are looking for a leader who can keep the core IT environment solid, put the right platforms and guardrails under home-built software, and teach non-programmers to work safely.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Keep Things Running**

* Own day-to-day IT across the business: computers, email, servers, networking, security and backups.
* Run Microsoft 365, including sign-in, multi-factor authentication (MFA), user access and licensing.
* Look after our on-premises server cluster, storage and network infrastructure.
* Oversee security monitoring and incident response together with our security monitoring partner.
* Maintain tested backups and the ability to restore systems and data quickly.
* Lead the help desk and set the service standards the business is held to.

**Own the Platforms**

* Set up and run, hands-on, the platforms our home-built tools live on.
* Own Liteline’s company GitHub organization, where code is saved with full history, including structure, permissions, single sign-on (SSO) and branch protection.
* Administer hosted databases (Supabase / Postgres), including access control, backups and recovery.
* Manage website and application hosting (Netlify), including deployments, domains and environments.
* Maintain a clear inventory of the tools in use, who owns each one and where it runs.

**Govern and Teach**

* Decide what AI assistants can access and set sensible guardrails for company data and credentials.
* Set light, practical rules that protect the business without getting in the way of the people building.
* Decide which home-built tools are business-critical and what level of protection each one needs.
* Run and rehearse restores so that recovery is proven, not assumed.
* Teach staff who are not programmers to work safely, for example explaining version control to someone in purchasing.
* Run training, enablement and “lunch and learn” sessions across the business.

**Team and Partners**

* Lead two on-site IT staff.
* Manage our outside partners for managed services, security monitoring and backup.
* Own the technology budget, licensing and vendor relationships, and bring forward stronger options as the market moves.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

We are looking for a hands-on technology leader who is equally comfortable running core IT and building platforms that sit under modern, AI-assisted development.

The successful candidate will understand infrastructure, identity and security, and will also understand how software is built, saved, deployed and recovered. Just as importantly, you will be able to explain those ideas in plain language to people who have never written code and help them adopt habits that last.

**Strong candidates will bring:**

* Hands-on experience setting up or administering a GitHub organization, including SSO and branch protection.
* Experience running a Microsoft Power Platform Centre of Excellence, citizen-developer or low-code programme.
* Hands-on experience running Supabase, Postgres, Netlify, Vercel or similar platforms.
* Solid Microsoft 365, identity, MFA, endpoint and security fundamentals.
* A track record of training and enabling non-technical staff, such as “lunch and learn” or enablement programmes.
* Experience building a function or process from scratch at a growing company.
* Clear communication and sound judgment about when rules help and when they get in the way.

There is no single path to this role. You might be:

* An IT lead at a 100-to-500-person manufacturer or distributor who personally ran a Power Platform governance programme, a low-code programme or the company’s GitHub organization.
* A developer or DevOps engineer who moved into an IT management role at a small or mid-sized company.
* A solutions architect or senior consultant at a managed services provider (MSP) serving small and mid-sized businesses, ready to go in-house.
* The “first IT hire” at a startup who set up sign-in, devices and GitHub from scratch, then moved to a mid-sized company.
* Experience in mid-sized manufacturing, distribution or wholesale is helpful but not required.

**REPORTING AND WORKING RELATIONSHIPS**

This position reports to the VP of Operations.

You will work closely with Liteline’s three Co-Presidents, who are technically capable and build their own tools, and with Finance, Product Development, Engineering and Customer Service. You will be a partner to the people building, not a gatekeeper.

**LOCATION AND WORKING ARRANGEMENT**

This position is based at Liteline's Richmond Hill head office and is on-site five days per week with regular presence at our distribution facilities.

The successful candidate should expect to be highly engaged with the business and to spend real time understanding how departments and facilities actually operate.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

This is a rare chance to shape how an established Canadian manufacturer builds and runs its technology at a moment when AI is changing who can create software.

Liteline is privately held, decisions are made without layers of approval, and good ideas get backed. Our leaders build with technology themselves and value this work. The Director of Business Technology will define the platforms, guardrails and habits that let the whole company build with confidence.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

Liteline offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental and life insurance following three months of service, and a group RRSP with partial company match.

.

You’ll take the time to understand not just what a customer is asking for, but why: their goals, priorities, and the outcomes they want to reach. You’ll then turn that understanding into a product configuration that fits them.

You’ll own the full configuration journey. That means writing the configuration specifications, setting up the product, verifying that every configuration works as intended, and delivering it to the customer. You’ll then prepare training materials and train customers so they’re confident using their configured solution from day one.

You’ll be the customer’s advocate inside Afflo.io, working closely with Customer Success Managers, Product, QA, Delivery, and Support teams to deliver a seamless customer experience.

What You’ll Do

Understand the customer

* Engage with customers to understand their needs, goals, and the reasons behind their requests, so the solution supports their real objectives.
* Review customer workflows, identify gaps, and capture needs as functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.

Configure the product

* Translate customer needs into configuration specifications covering workflows, settings, roles, rules, and other product options.
* Configure the product for each customer based on the approved specifications.
* Maintain configuration specifications as living documents, keeping them accurate and up to date as customer needs change.
* Manage changes to customer configurations and requirements with clear traceability and formal change control.

Verify and deliver

* Verify every configuration against the specification and the customer’s acceptance criteria before delivery.
* Support customers throughout their user acceptance testing (UAT), from preparing test scenarios and guiding their testers to answering questions as they test.
* Triage UAT findings raised by the customer, determine whether each one is a configuration change, a training need, or a product defect, and make sure it is properly addressed and closed with the customer.
* Perform regression checks, release verification, and post-release validation to confirm that configurations keep working as expected.
* Support customer integration and data migration work by analyzing their data and systems, defining data mapping and transformation rules, and documenting data exchange requirements such as API events and formats.
* Use SQL to analyze customer data and confirm data quality and integrity.
* Deliver configured solutions to customers and support their move from implementation to steady-state operations.

Train and enable

* Prepare customer-facing training materials, including guides, user manuals, quick-reference sheets, and demo scripts tailored to each customer’s configuration.
* Deliver training sessions and product demonstrations to customer users and administrators.
* Gather feedback after training and refine materials to improve adoption.

Support ongoing success

* Monitor customer usage, engagement, health, and service quality indicators, and escalate risks to the Customer Success Manager.
* Coordinate customer requests, issues, defects, and feedback across internal teams, track them through resolution, verify fixes, and keep customers informed until each item is closed.
* Maintain success plans, process maps, data flows, quality checklists, action items, and account documentation.
* Take part in post-implementation and post-release reviews to confirm that solutions continue to meet customer needs.
* Spot recurring customer issues, adoption challenges, and configuration or quality trends, and share ideas for continuous improvement.

* A strong ability to uncover what customers truly need and why, and to turn that into practical solutions.
* Experience writing configuration specifications, requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Experience supporting customers through UAT and triaging their findings, plus practical experience verifying configurations through regression and end-to-end testing.

Nice to Have

**Job Description Summary**
The Director of Customer Services and Informatics is a senior leadership position within UBC Facilities. The Director provides strategic leadership for Facilities customer service function, customer service plan, business project management, business analysis, informatics, enterprise maintenance management system (EMMS), facilities information and inventory systems, change management, call centre management and clerical support services. This role develops strategic objectives, implements and monitors procedures and policies that enable Facilities to meet or exceed agreed customer service standards across the entire campus. In addition, this division provides all business units within Facilities the necessary business support both by providing the necessary analytics and analysis to ensure continuous improvements continue across the department. The Director is responsible for the development and sustainment of the Facilities Emergency Management Plan.
  
  
The Director of Customer Services and Informatics is the Facilities representative for customer engagement, business projects and initiatives, space inventory data, building and infrastructure records drawings and information, analytics, reporting, technology and continuous improvement initiatives. They partner with Information Technology (IT) and Safety and Risk Services (SRS) - Emergency Management, Project Management Office (PMO), Integrated Service Centre (ISC), Communications & Engagement for strategic alignment and resource allocation.
  
  
The Director leads a workforce of approximately 35 staff in professional and unionized positions. Prepares strategic and business plans and supports an annual Facilities budget of approximately $150M.
  
  
**Organizational Status**
This position reports directly to the Associate Vice-President, Facilities, and serves as a member of the Facilities Leadership team. Works closely with other Directors, Senior Managers, and Managers as well as other department‘s leadership teams. This position is the senior leader within Facilities responsible for implementing business transformational initiatives with the support of other divisions, monitoring operational progress through the analysis and reporting of information to guide evidence-based decision-making.
  
  
**Work Performed**

* Provides strategic leadership to the Facilities Leadership team through the Customer Services and Informatics division to execute a full range of department-wide services to meet targets and objectives of the Strategic Plan. This includes supporting and developing business plans; ensuring consistent and effective implementation; enhancing integration; standardizing services and business practices; maximizing efficiencies and cost savings.
* Responsible for business transformational projects through assessment, analysis, design and implementation; champions the implementation of change management initiatives, process and execution.
* Leads the development of a Monitoring Framework with key performance indicators for each unit within the department and develops remedial and continuous improvement plans in relation to results. This framework includes leading and lagging indicators and an effective client satisfaction monitoring and reporting system to evaluate the services provided by the entire Facilities group.
* Leads the facilities information and inventory systems function, including university space inventory data, building and infrastructure record drawings, key plans, emergency response plans, and maintenance manuals.
* Provides direction and implements change management methodologies to effectively lead and optimize key projects across Facilities.
* Mentors and coaches change management in relation to the implementation of business initiatives.
* Liaises with academic, administrative and ancillary customers, engineers, architects and external clients to ensure that the facilities needs of the university are being met.
* Supports and provides direction to the Senior Facilities Manager in providing strategic leadership to the Facilities Managers working in the geographic zone model. Through the Senior Facilities Manager, oversees the delivery of equal, consistent and effectively prioritized service delivery within the campus zones.
* Provides strategic leadership on sustainment of Facilities and University information systems in support of enterprise maintenance management, asset management, stores inventory, space inventory, records drawings, records management, and project management.
* Provides strategic leadership and/or oversees development of innovative business solutions and services that integrate data and reporting capabilities to augment decision-making.
* Oversees work of various teams performing quality testing of data and information and reconciling across sources, presenting facts and evidence in dashboards to assist in effective evidence-based decision making.
* Provides strategic leadership to the Facilities Service Centre who are responsible for handling inbound and outbound calls regarding buildings and grounds.
* Responsible for administrative/clerical support services for the Facilities group.
* Provides direction in the completion of regulatory and skills development training for all staff within Facilities which includes developing plans, implementing and evaluating, department-wide strategies.
* Leads and directs the development of the Facilities Emergency Management Plan, including emergency preparedness exercises for the department in collaboration with SRS, Emergency Management.
* Works with SRS and implements consistent health, safety and environmental initiatives, which, includes safety committee, accident investigations, safety training and safety recommendations within the Customer Services and Informatics division.
* Responsible for human resource practices including recruitment, orientation, training, performance evaluation, discipline, labor relations and dismissal within the Customer Services and Informatics division in collaboration with Human Resources.
* Performs other related duties, including but not limited to:

+ Representing Facilities on various university committees. Develops working relationships and partnerships with key stakeholders across UBC.
+ Acting on behalf of the Associate Vice-President, Facilities.

The MHCW RCP, in alignment with Ontario Health-Cancer Care Ontario (OH-CCO), oversees the delivery and quality of cancer services for over 2 million residents across Mississauga Halton and Central West, including Etobicoke, Mississauga, Halton Hills, Oakville, Milton, Georgetown, Bolton, Brampton, Caledon, Malton, Orangeville, Rexdale, Shelburne and Woodbridge.
  
  
**Position Overview**
As the Regional Cancer Program Director for the Mississauga Halton Central West Regional Cancer Program, you will report to the Regional Vice President. A broad and influential leadership role that includes both a regional and programmatic mandate, you will lead regional planning and performance improvement in one of the largest regional cancer programs in the province. The Regional Director leads an inter-professional team providing system and regional leadership, relationship management, performance management and financial and risk management for cancer services across the region. Cancer Services include Systemic Treatment, Radiation Therapy, Surgical Oncology, Cancer Imaging, Pathology & Lab Medicine, Prevention, Cancer Screening, Primary Care, Psycho-social Oncology, Patient Education, and Survivorship. Additionally, the role provides integration and engagement/support for the Regional Endoscopy Services, Complex Malignant Haematology, Regional Cancer Informatics and Patient Experience across 4 hospitals partners (10 hospital sites), and 34 OSBP sites.
  
  
The Regional Director, in collaboration with the Regional Vice President and in alignment with the Ontario Cancer Plan 6, will lead the delivery of strategic initiatives to ensure quality care for patients and their families, and will play a vital role in building and sustaining excellence in regional service delivery.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Develop and implement key strategic initiatives aligned with the Ontario Cancer Plan linked with the MHCW RCP’s strategic plan, goals and objectives
* Build high performing teams that implement local and regional aspects of the Ontario Cancer Plan
* Implement the clinical quality improvement agenda of the provincial program for all cancer clinical service delivery areas
* Establish and maintain operational partnerships in the region necessary to advance cancer system performance and priorities as well as jointly develop solutions to cancer system and related challenges
* Together with the RVP, facilitate cancer service capacity planning within the Regional Cancer Program and as part of province-wide cancer planning.
* Together with the RVP, build and maintain relationships with a range of care networks, community providers and cross-sector agencies to advance a partnership strategy that is integrated and outcome-focused
* Support performance oversight of the cancer system in the region (including performance of volumes, data, access safety and quality) and lead efforts to improve regional performance
* Champion provincial cancer standards to ensure these are put into practice at the point of care, through dissemination of standards and compliance monitoring
* Support the RVP to oversee cancer related funding within the RCP, assessing existing capacity and developing strategies to optimize regional resources
* Collaborate and liaise with OH-CCO and the Regional Directors throughout the province through participation and leadership on provincial committees and projects with the goal to advance the overall care experience for persons with cancer in our community

**Qualifications**
The successful candidate will possess the following experience, skills, attributes, and capabilities:
  
  

* Master's degree in health administration, Health Sciences, Business Administration, or related field
* Minimum 5–7 years of progressive leadership experience within a complex healthcare environment, preferably within oncology
* Experience within the Ontario cancer system and strong knowledge of regional service delivery models is considered an asset
* Demonstrated proficiency in strategic and operational planning, management principles and business case development
* Knowledge of quality improvement methodologies, financial practices and risk management principles
* Demonstrated strong analytical skills
* Demonstrated excellence in communication, stakeholder engagement, facilitation, and relationship management
* History of building constructive and effective relationships and gaining credibility in other organizations and within those organizations across disciplines, divisions, departments and programs
* Demonstrated ability to think strategically and implement sophisticated programs and initiatives
* Excellent oral and written communication skills
* Highly motivated and enthusiastic team player who thrives in ambiguity
* Strong influencer, ability to listen, mediate and negotiate
* Demonstrated experience in supervising professionals and team building
* Change management and project management skills a strong asset

**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director, Client Support and Enablement based in Canada.**
As Director, Client Support and Enablement, you will lead the strategy, development, and execution of customer support and enablement operations for enterprise clients within a growing SaaS environment. You will oversee service reliability, platform adoption, and the overall customer experience, ensuring clients receive timely, effective support throughout their journey. Combining strategic leadership with operational execution, you will build and scale a high-performing team, establish service standards, and implement processes that support sustainable growth. Working closely with Account Management, Product, Engineering, Launch, and Ad Operations, you will drive seamless collaboration and continuous platform improvement. You will also leverage analytics, automation, and AI-powered tools to improve efficiency, anticipate customer needs, and strengthen service delivery. This is an opportunity to shape a critical customer-facing function within an innovative technology business serving leading enterprise retail media partners.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Customer Support Strategy: Define and lead the overall Customer Support and Enablement (CSE) strategy, including the team's mission, service catalog, operating model, responsibilities, and collaboration frameworks with Account Management, Launch, and Ad Operations.
* Team Leadership and Development: Recruit, build, and manage a high-performing support and enablement team. Establish clear responsibilities, support career development, manage performance, and foster a culture of accountability and continuous learning.
* Scalable Support Operations: Implement a pooled support model with a centralized service queue and cross-training practices to ensure consistent account coverage, even during employee absences or team transitions.
* Workforce Planning: Develop multi-year staffing, resource allocation, coverage, and technology plans to support business expansion across new retail partners and geographic regions while maintaining service quality.
* Service Level Management: Establish, monitor, and report on service-level agreements (SLAs), resolution times, ticket backlogs, and quality standards. Own ticket prioritization, escalation procedures, operational runbooks, and service performance across all accounts.
* Incident and Escalation Management: Lead communications during critical Sev-0 and Sev-1 incidents, ensuring timely updates to enterprise clients and internal stakeholders. Oversee root-cause analyses (RCAs) and ensure findings and corrective actions are documented and shared.
* Operational Coverage: Collaborate with Ad Operations to establish clear support coverage models for urgent requests and after-hours incidents.
* Client Training and Enablement: Lead customer education initiatives, including platform demonstrations, training sessions, FAQs, product guides, and communications about platform updates and new features.
* Help Center Management: Own the Help Center and its development using tools such as Freshdesk, including knowledge base architecture, documentation, article creation, and publishing strategies designed to improve self-service and reduce support ticket volume.
* Platform Adoption: Monitor feature adoption and platform engagement after launch, identify low-usage patterns, and collaborate with Account Management and Product teams to improve adoption and customer outcomes.
* Performance Reporting: Oversee weekly campaign pacing and advertiser reporting, as well as monthly ticket-trend analysis. Translate operational data into actionable insights for leadership and enterprise clients.

**Role and responsibilities**

The Public Health Physician provides medical expertise and consultation to support provincial surveillance, risk assessment, preparedness and response, outbreak management, risk communication and the development and evaluation of public health policy, guidance and programs. The physician will work closely with other CDPR physicians and multidisciplinary teams on the development of strategic activities, public health policies, programs, and practices in collaboration with operational counterparts. The Public Health Physician consults, partners, and collaborates with Regional Health Authorities, First Nations Health Authority, Métis Nation British Columbia, Office of the Provincial Health Officer, Ministry of Health and other provincial ministries to characterize and address various communicable diseases.

The role will support the CDPR Unit and BCCDC in the development, monitoring, evaluating, and disseminating provincial public health policies, guidelines, and standards of practice to support quality service delivery. In collaboration with other public health leaders, this role will identify evidence-based outcomes, develop quality indicators and care pathways, ensure compliance with accreditation standards, and coordinate or participate in quality improvement activities with a focus on patient safety and improved population health outcomes.

This position has a focus on Major Capital Projects ($25 million and greater) where if cost overruns were to occur, there is potential to do significant harm to both the reputation and financial position of the City of Winnipeg. This position provides the challenge, scrutiny, analysis and review of departmentally prepared project business plans, budgets, project plans and Administrative Reports to ensure projects are appropriately budgeted and likely to be delivered on time and within budget.

The Executive Director provides leadership consistent with the mission, vision and values of the organization to the Care Community staff that provides quality resident care in an environment that is safe, comfortable and promotes maximum resident independence, and meets residents' physical, emotional, spiritual and social needs.

* Administers, directs and manages all activities in the home through effective strategic and operational planning, ethical decision making and innovation.
