The **Department of Medicine** in the **Cumming School of Medicine** invites applications for a **Research & Laboratory Coordinator**. This Full-time Fixed Term position is for approximately 1 year (based on length of grant funding), with the possibility of extension.

This position reports to the Research Manager with accountabilities to the Principal Investigator, and works as a member of the Coffin Research Group and the broader Calgary Liver Unit research program. The position primarily provides clinical research coordination and administrative support through the Canadian Hepatitis B Network (www.canadianhbvnetwork.ca) and the CIHR Pan-Canadian Network for HIV and STBBI Clinical Trials Research (CTN+; www.ctnplus.ca) including ethics and regulatory administration, participant recruitment and follow-up, data collection and entry, and study documentation. The position also providesbasic/translational laboratory research support for the Coffin Research Group and the Calgary Liver Unit Health Information and Biorepository (CLU HIB).

The incumbent supports clinical research staff with participant recruitment and follow-up, data collection and entry, preparation of study materials, and patient-facing research activities under established study protocols and with appropriate training and oversight. The position also provides broad organizational and administrative support to research programs including scheduling and minuting meetings, updating websites and social media, drafting of reports and other research outputs including posters or presentations. The position will perform laboratory procedures of moderate complexity involving animal and human biological specimens and support the collection, processing, storage, tracking, and shipment of research samples. The participant will need to be comfortable working with pre-clinical animal models for hepatitis B under supervision of the veterinary team.

**Summary of Key Responsibilities** (job functions include but are not limited to):

* Master's degree in a relevant science or health science discipline required (e.g., biomedical sciences, molecular biology, immunology, microbiology, virology, biochemistry, or related field), with demonstrated experience in clinical research coordination and research administration
* Experience in clinical or human participant research, including recruitment, informed consent support, chart review, data collection, or participant-facing activities is an asset
* Strong organizational and time management skills, with demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects, competing priorities, and deadlines with a high degree of accuracy
* Knowledge of research ethics, confidentiality, Good Clinical Practice, and applicable University and health-system research requirements is an asset
* Demonstrated hands-on laboratory experience in a biomedical or basic science research environment required
* Experience handling animal and human biological specimens such as blood, plasma/serum, PBMCs, or tissue required; experience working with infectious specimens is an asset
* Knowledge of common molecular, cellular, or immunological laboratory methods; experience with techniques such as sample processing, DNA/RNA isolation, PCR/qPCR, ELISA, cell culture, flow cytometry, or related methods is an asset
* Experience in laboratory animal research is an asset
* Experience with research sample management, biobanking, inventory systems, or laboratory databases is an asset
* Excellent attention to detail and accurate documentation skills required
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills and demonstrated ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team
* Intermediate to advanced skills in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint); experience with REDCap, Qualtrics, reference management software, sequence, bioinformatics or similar research platforms is an asset
* Ability and willingness to learn new laboratory techniques, research procedures, software, and administrative processes, flexible working schedule, and to take on varied assignments as program needs change

**Qualifications / Requirements:**

Clinical Research Support:

* Assist research coordinators and investigators with screening and identifying potentially eligible research participants according to approved study criteria and procedures
* Contact participants, schedule research visits, provide approved study information, and support participant recruitment, consent, and follow-up activities within the incumbent's training and delegated responsibilities
* Assist with patient-facing research visits, including preparation of study materials, questionnaires, sample collection kits, and visit documentation
* Collect, transcribe, verify, and enter study-related data from source documents or medical records into approved research databases and case report forms
* Maintain study records, participant confidentiality, and accurate documentation in accordance with ethics approvals, protocols, SOPs, and privacy requirements

Research Program and Administrative Support:

* Assist with preparation of research posters, presentations, figures, tables, abstracts, literature summaries, and other research materials
* Support website and social media management, including developing, updating and maintaining research-related content for the Canadian Hepatitis B Network (CanHepB)
* Assist with preparation and organization of study documents, meeting materials, training records, and research files
* Attend laboratory, project, and Calgary Liver Unit meetings as appropriate and communicate progress, priorities, and issues to the supervisor and research team
* Coordinate CTN+ meetings, both in-person and virtual, including scheduling and meeting logistics, participation in meetings, preparation and maintenance of meeting minutes and related records, and preparation of quarterly reports

Laboratory and Biobank Support:

* Process research specimens according to study protocols and SOPs, including receipt, labeling, centrifugation, aliquoting, storage, retrieval, and preparation for analysis or shipment
* Perform assigned laboratory experiments and assays using established methods; document procedures, results, deviations, and quality-control activities accurately
* Maintain accurate electronic and paper records for specimens, experiments, inventories, and biobank activities
* Support CLU HIB sample acquisition, deposition, retrieval, processing, storage, inventory, and organization across research projects
* Maintain laboratory work areas and support the safe and reliable operation of laboratory equipment, refrigerators/freezers, and other research infrastructure
* Monitor and replenish laboratory supplies and reagents; assist with ordering, receiving, inventory, and organization of consumables
* Assist with preparation and shipment of biological samples in accordance with applicable SOPs and transportation requirements

The Senior Threat Hunter & DFIR Specialist, a part of the Digital Security Group, is a senior hands-on practitioner responsible for proactive threat hunting, digital forensics, incident investigation, authorized penetration testing, adversary simulation and security-control validation across KPMG’s enterprise environment. This role reports to the Director of Security Operations.

The successful candidate will independently investigate complex security incidents, reconstruct attack paths, determine scope and root cause, preserve evidence, and guide containment, eradication and recovery. The role combines advanced Windows and cloud forensics with attacker tradecraft and offensive-security expertise.

This individual will reproduce attacks in approved environments, convert evidence into defensible conclusions, and strengthen prevention, detection and response through actionable findings, improved detections and remediation validation.

What you will do:

The Senior Threat Hunter & DFIR Specialist leads complex investigations, proactive threat hunting, and authorized adversary testing across endpoint, identity, network, application, Microsoft 365, Azure, and hybrid-cloud environments.

* Lead high-severity incident investigations through evidence preservation, scoping, containment, eradication, recovery, and root-cause analysis, reconstructing attack timelines and identifying compromised systems, identities, persistence, lateral movement, and potential data exfiltration
* Collect and analyze endpoint, disk, memory, cloud, identity, application, and network evidence, including Windows and Linux forensics, while maintaining forensic integrity and chain of custody
* Conduct hypothesis-driven threat hunts using Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Sentinel, KQL, and enterprise telemetry to identify malicious activity and emerging threats

* Reproduce attacks in approved environments to validate findings, forensic artifacts, detections, and remediation effectiveness

This position may require on-call and after-hours work, as needed to support KPMG business needs.

* 2+ years of relevant cybersecurity or enterprise IT experience, with hands-on experience in threat hunting, DFIR, incident response, security operations, penetration testing, or red teaming
* Strong knowledge of enterprise systems, endpoint security, SIEM/EDR, identity, networking, cloud security, and attacker tradecraft, including MITRE ATT&CK
* Advanced Windows forensics knowledge and working knowledge of Linux forensics, with the ability to independently investigate compromises and reconstruct attack chains from forensic evidence
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender XDR, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Sentinel, KQL, Entra ID, Microsoft 365, and Azure security telemetry
* Experience with forensic and endpoint triage tools such as KAPE or Velociraptor, including the collection and analysis of disk, memory, VM, and cloud evidence
* Experience with penetration testing and adversary emulation across applications, APIs, networks, identity, and cloud environments, using tools such as Burp Suite, Nmap, Metasploit, BloodHound, Impacket, NetExec, or Wireshark
* Proficiency with PowerShell and Python for security investigations, automation, threat hunting, or testing
* Strong analytical judgment and technical communication skills, with demonstrated curiosity and continuous learning in cybersecurity
* Relevant certifications such as GCFA, GCIH, CRTO, or OSEP are considered assets however are not required

Permissions are the front door to everything a customer builds on AWS. When access is too broad, a single leaked credential or misconfigured policy can expose an entire business. When access is too narrow, builders get blocked, workarounds creep in, and security quietly erodes. Most customers are not IAM experts, and they should not have to be. Yet they are responsible for getting access exactly right across thousands of accounts, millions of resources, and policies that change every day.  
  
Now the problem is accelerating. AI agents are writing code, deploying infrastructure, and acting on builders' behalf at a pace no human review process can match. Every one of those agents needs permissions, and agents are remarkably good at finding and using permissions they were never meant to have. Excess access that sat unnoticed for years can now be discovered and exercised in minutes. If we make least privilege hard, customers will either slow down or open the doors wide. Neither is acceptable. The teams that make secure access the easy default will define how the next generation of software gets built safely.  
  
That is the mission of the AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) Access Analyzer team. As a Software Development Manager, you will lead engineers who make IAM easier to use and more secure by default for millions of AWS customers. Your team will help customers see what access is possible across their whole AWS environment, cut back overly privileged access, troubleshoot access problems quickly, and preview the impact of security policy changes before they deploy them. You will also build tools that builders' AI agents use to generate better, least-privilege policies, so builders can move faster with agentic development while their agents get the access they need and nothing more.  
  
The work spans distributed systems at scale, automated reasoning, and customer-facing experiences, and the impact is direct: fewer security incidents, faster builders, and customers who trust that their access is right. You set a high engineering bar, drive operational excellence, and turn ambitious ideas into products customers rely on. If you want your work to make the cloud simpler and safer for everyone who builds on it, this is the role for you.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Define and execute product and architecture strategy for the Access Analyzer platform, working backwards from customers of every size to deliver deeper access insights across their entire AWS estate
* Build a culture of rapid prototyping: get creative, turn new ideas into working prototypes quickly, use them to earn stakeholder buy-in, and iterate on designs in days rather than months
* Own the team roadmap, plans, and deliverables, balancing customer features, platform investments, and operational improvements, and making clear tradeoffs as priorities evolve
* Proactively identify risks, mitigate them before they become roadblocks, and use sound judgment on when and how to escalate to senior leadership
* Own system reliability, scalability, and operational metrics for services that run at AWS scale
* Influence across organizational boundaries, partnering with product management, UX, solutions architects, and AWS service teams to align on priorities and drive adoption
* Use AI tooling to improve engineering productivity, automate workflows, and raise the bar on operational efficiency
* Hire and develop the best, building a strong, healthy, and diverse team

[Confidential] is building a new team to deliver complete IT fit-outs of data halls, from an empty room to live, tested and documented computing capacity. Once the building shell, power and cooling are in place, our crews take the white space from A to Z: receiving and staging, rack and cabinet placement, overhead pathways, bonding and grounding, copper and high-density fibre, network and server hardware, testing, power-up and handover to the client.

As a Senior Technician, you are the go-to technical lead on site. You turn drawings and cable schedules into the day's work, run a crew of Level 2 technicians, do the hard technical work yourself, solve the problems others can't, and sign off on quality before anything is handed over. This is a working lead role: you'll spend most of your day hands-on alongside your crew.

**The scope: a full data hall fit-out, A to Z**

Every project follows the same lifecycle, and you'll lead your crew through all of it:

1. Pre-construction: Review drawings, rack elevations, cable schedules, port maps and fibre plans; confirm site readiness; flag design conflicts before work starts

2. Receiving and staging: Receive, inspect, inventory and stage racks, cabinets, cable, optics and hardware; report damaged or missing items

3. Racks and cabinets: Lay out, place, level, bolt together and anchor racks and cabinets to the floor plan; install containment, doors, side panels, blanking panels and cable managers

4. Bonding and grounding: Install and verify rack and pathway bonding to the site grounding system per drawings and standards

5. Overhead pathways: Install ladder rack, basket tray, fibre guide/runway and supports (threaded rod, Unistrut), keeping clearances and segregation to plan

6. Structured cabling: Pull, route, dress and terminate copper (Cat6/6A) and fibre, including pre-terminated MPO/MTP trunks, LC, patch panels and cassettes; maintain bend radius and fill ratios

7. Rack-and-stack: Install servers, switches, storage, GPU/AI systems, optics and rack PDUs to rack elevations; patch to port maps and cut sheets

8. Labelling and records: Label every cable, port, panel and rack to the client's scheme (TIA-606 practice); barcode-scan and record assets

9. Testing and certification: Fibre inspection and cleaning, OLTS (Tier 1) and OTDR (Tier 2) testing, copper certification, continuity and polarity checks; fix and retest any failures

10. Power-up and validation: Support power-on and green-light checks, out-of-band management connectivity, link and loopback testing, and burn-in with the client's engineers

11. Quality and handover: Run QA/QC inspections and punch lists, complete as-built drawings, test reports and asset records, and walk the client through handover

12. Ongoing work: Moves, adds and changes, migrations, decommissioning and remediation in live environments

**What you'll do**

**Lead the crew**

* Turn project plans and drawings into a clear, ordered task list and assign work to match each technician's skill level

* Run pre-task briefings and job hazard assessments before work starts each day

* Manage handoffs between crews, shifts and other trades, and keep materials and dependencies lined up so nobody is waiting

* Coach and develop Level 2 technicians on the job, check their work, and help them grow toward Level 3

* Hold the team to safety and workmanship standards, and use stop-work authority when something isn't right

* Report daily progress, blockers and material needs to the Fit-Out Manager

**Own the technical work**

* Lead installs, power-up, migrations and project closeout from start to finish

* Run advanced fibre and network testing, including fibre inspection and cleaning, OTDR traces, power meter and light source testing, copper certification, and loopback tests

* Interpret test results, find faults (dirty or damaged connectors, macrobends, bad splices, polarity errors) and see the fix through to a passing retest

* Troubleshoot physical-layer issues across fibre, optics, copper, power, cooling and hardware, combining alarm data, test results and hands-on inspection to find the real cause and confirm the fix

* Step in to lead the response when a physical infrastructure issue affects service

* Work safely around live production equipment and within the client's change windows and access rules

**Guarantee the quality**

* Inspect finished work for routing, dressing, bend radius, labelling, bonding and record accuracy before handover

* Make sure test reports, as-built drawings and asset records match what's in the room

* Track defects and rework, and help find and fix the cause so it doesn't repeat

* Give project leads and client contacts clear, timely updates on progress, risks and any escalations

**What you bring**

* 3–5 years hands-on in data centre operations or deployment, optical networking, structured cabling, telecom or field engineering (or equivalent proven skill)

* Experience leading a small crew or technical team on site

* Hands-on experience with rack-and-stack, overhead pathways (ladder rack, basket tray, fibre guide), and bonding and grounding

* Working knowledge of single-mode and multimode fibre, MPO/MTP trunks and polarity, LC connectivity, and copper termination

* Expert-level troubleshooting and confident use of fibre test equipment, including OTDRs, OLTS (power meter and light source), VFLs, inspection scopes and copper certifiers (e.g. Fluke DSX)

* Able to read and work from drawings, rack elevations, cable schedules, port maps and cut sheets

* Familiar with BICSI and TIA cabling and labelling practice

* Organized and detail-focused with documentation, test reports and asset records

* Clear, professional written and spoken English for client-facing updates

* Willingness to travel to other sites as projects require

* Technical training from a college, trade school, military or industry certification program, or equivalent experience

**Nice to have**

* CFOT/CFOS, BICSI Technician, CDCP/CDCS or CompTIA Network+/Server+

* Experience on hyperscale, colocation, AI/GPU or carrier builds

* Ontario Working at Heights, WHMIS and elevated work platform training

* Experience with DCIM tools, barcode/asset systems or test-result software (e.g. Fluke LinkWare)

* Eligibility for client security screening

**Work environment**

***Work is on active data centre construction sites and in live data halls. Expect noise, hot and cold aisles, required PPE, and strict site access and safety rules.***

**Why join**

* Lead a crew on large-scale data centre infrastructure work from day one

* Work across the full fit-out lifecycle, not just one piece of it

* Path into supervision and site management as the team grows

L’initiative AI Fabric de Bell est à l’avant-garde de la création d’un réseau canadien de calcul d’intelligence artificielle sécurisé et souverain. À titre de directeur(trice) de programme, vous serez responsable de la réalisation de bout en bout du programme national de construction des centres de données. Vous assurerez la coordination de la portée, des échéanciers, des budgets et de l’exécution interfonctionnelle à travers plusieurs sites réalisés simultanément. Votre rôle sera essentiel pour permettre à Bell de livrer ces infrastructures critiques dans les délais, les budgets et les standards établis, à mesure que l’initiative prend de l’ampleur à l’échelle nationale.
  
  
**Principales responsabilités**

* Assumer l’entière responsabilité de la livraison du programme national de construction des centres de données, en assurant l’intégration de la portée, des échéanciers, des budgets et des exigences de qualité à travers plusieurs sites réalisés en parallèle.
* Orchestrer l’exécution interfonctionnelle entre les équipes de construction, d’ingénierie, de mise en service, d’approvisionnement et de contrôle de programme afin d’assurer l’alignement sur les objectifs du programme.
* Établir et gouverner le cadre de réalisation du programme, incluant les points de contrôle décisionnels (stage gates), les jalons, les mécanismes de gouvernance et les responsabilités décisionnelles à l’échelle du portefeuille.
* Assurer la responsabilité du calendrier directeur intégré ainsi que du budget global du programme, en favorisant la prévisibilité, la transparence et la rigueur dans la gestion des échéanciers pour l’ensemble des projets.
* Diriger la gestion des risques, la gouvernance des changements et la gestion des interdépendances à l’échelle du programme, en identifiant et en résolvant les enjeux systémiques avant qu’ils n’affectent la livraison.
* Fournir des rapports de niveau exécutif à la direction du Réseau d'IA tissé de Bell et des Programmes d’investissement, en transformant des informations complexes sur l’avancement des projets en analyses claires facilitant la prise de décision.
* Superviser les aspects financiers du programme, les prévisions budgétaires et la planification des investissements en partenariat avec les équipes des finances et du contrôle de programme.
* Diriger la planification et la priorisation des ressources à travers les différents sites afin d’équilibrer les besoins concurrents à mesure que le programme prend de l’expansion.
* Développer et faire évoluer les capacités de gestion de programme de Bell à une étape clé de croissance, en implantant des processus reproductibles, des guides d’exécution et des mécanismes de transfert des leçons apprises à travers le portefeuille.
* Agir à titre de principal point d’escalade et d’interlocuteur exécutif auprès des directeurs de site, des responsables fonctionnels et des partenaires externes chargés de la livraison.

**Qualifications Essentielles**

* Plus de 15 années d’expérience dans la direction de grands programmes d’investissement, incluant une expérience directe dans des centres de données hyperscale ou des infrastructures critiques (portefeuilles multisites et de plusieurs milliards de dollars privilégiés).
* Feuille de route démontrée dans la gestion complète de programmes comportant plusieurs projets de construction exécutés simultanément, et non uniquement dans la gestion de projets individuels.
* Excellente maîtrise des disciplines de gestion de programme, notamment la planification intégrée, le contrôle des coûts et des budgets, la gestion des risques et la gouvernance des changements.
* Solide compréhension de l’ensemble du cycle de livraison d’un centre de données, incluant la construction, l’ingénierie, les systèmes MEP et la mise en service jusqu’au transfert aux opérations.
* Capacité démontrée à intégrer, coordonner et mobiliser des équipes interfonctionnelles diversifiées ainsi que des partenaires externes de réalisation.
* Expertise reconnue en gouvernance de programme, en gestion par étapes décisionnelles (stage-gate) et en présentation de rapports à la haute direction.
* Forte présence exécutive et excellentes compétences relationnelles permettant d’influencer et de remettre en question de façon constructive des leaders de l’ingénierie, de la construction, des finances et de la haute direction.
* Expérience dans la création et le développement d’une organisation de gestion de programme à partir d’une phase de démarrage ou de mise en place.
* Diplôme universitaire en génie, en gestion de la construction ou dans une discipline connexe; les titres professionnels PMP, PgMP, ing. ou une certification équivalente sont fortement privilégiés.
* Disponibilité à voyager à l’échelle nationale entre les différents sites de construction à mesure que le portefeuille de projets prend de l’expansion.

**Job Description Summary**

The Director of Customer Services and Informatics is a senior leadership position within UBC Facilities. The Director provides strategic leadership for Facilities customer service function, customer service plan, business project management, business analysis, informatics, enterprise maintenance management system (EMMS), facilities information and inventory systems, change management, call centre management and clerical support services. This role develops strategic objectives, implements and monitors procedures and policies that enable Facilities to meet or exceed agreed customer service standards across the entire campus. In addition, this division provides all business units within Facilities the necessary business support both by providing the necessary analytics and analysis to ensure continuous improvements continue across the department. The Director is responsible for the development and sustainment of the Facilities Emergency Management Plan.

The Director of Customer Services and Informatics is the Facilities representative for customer engagement, business projects and initiatives, space inventory data, building and infrastructure records drawings and information, analytics, reporting, technology and continuous improvement initiatives. * Provide input for value engineering and optimization options, highlighting cost impacts.
* Monitor project budget and expenditure against approved cost plans.
* Evaluate cost impact of design changes, site instructions, and scope variations.
* Prepare cost projections, cash‑flow forecasts, and financial status reports for the client.
* Carry out and/or validate measurements from drawings and on site for interim valuations.
* Coordinate with site teams to verify physical progress and reconcile with contractor claims.
* Maintain detailed records of measured quantities and variations for audit trail and final account.
* Support negotiations with contractors to reach commercially fair settlements.
* Ensure compliance with contract conditions (FIDIC or equivalent) related to notices, timelines, and procedures.
* Assist in preparation and agreement of final accounts.
* Identify cost and commercial risks (inflation, quantity overruns, design changes, delays) and highlight to PMC leadership.
* Prepare regular cost reports and dashboards for the client.
* Work closely with: Planning team to align cost data with programme progress, Design team to understand design developments and their cost implications, Construction managers to obtain site inputs on quantities, productivity, and logistics.
* Attend coordination and progress meetings to stay updated on project status and potential commercial impacts.
* Communicate clearly with contractors and consultants on cost and contract matters, maintaining a professional and neutral approach.
* Ensure proper documentation and filing of: Contracts, addenda, and variation orders, Payment certificates and supporting measurement records, Correspondence related to commercial issues and claims.
* Support implementation of PMC cost management procedures and templates.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of cost control processes and benchmarking for future projects.

  

**What Required Skills You'll Bring:**

  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Quantity Surveying, Civil Engineering, or related discipline; professional QS membership (e.g., MRICS) is an advantage.
* Typically 3-8 years of experience in quantity surveying and cost management on building projects, preferably mixed‑use or large real estate developments.
* Experience within PMC organizations, consultants, or major contractors.
* Strong understanding of: Standard methods of measurement and BOQ preparation, Contract forms (e.g., FIDIC, NEC, local standard forms), Construction techniques for buildings and infrastructure, and their cost drivers.
* Proficiency in: MS Excel (advanced) for cost analysis and reporting, Cost management/QS software (e.g., Candy, CostX, or similar – desirable), MS Project/Primavera (basic understanding) for linking cost and time.
* Excellent numerical and analytical skills with high attention to detail.
* Strong negotiation and communication skills.
* Ability to work under time pressure while maintaining accuracy and integrity.
* Good understanding of both technical construction aspects and commercial implications.
* Ethical, transparent, and client‑focused approach to cost management.

THE 30%: DISCIPLINE ACCOUNTABILITY The Head of Engineering owns what "good engineering" means at Maestro, independent of the product line.

* Identifies and removes friction in how engineering work gets done company-wide, streamlining processes that slow every team down in the same way. • Is the ultimate accountable owner for engineering management practice (how EMs lead, how performance is evaluated, how the craft is grown) even where day-to-day people management is embedded in product teams. **Enterprise Financial Risk (EFR) Overview:**
  
Enterprise Financial Risk (EFR) seeks to deliver effective independent risk management of the activities and processes associated with managing the Company’s capital, liquidity and interest rate risks, including price risk in the CFO managed securities portfolio. As the Chief Risk Officer (CRO) function covering the Chief Financial Officer (CFO) Group, we also bring together a holistic point of view across all seven risk types for the Company’s CFO.
  
  
The team helps Bank of America grow responsibly through developing our teammates, promoting opportunity and an inclusive culture, and approaching our work with intellectual curiosity. EFR delivers its mission through a steadfast commitment to its values: cultivating diversity of thought and valuing different perspectives and experiences; promoting learning, fostering relationships and creativity; and developing talent, advancing careers, and creating leaders within Global Risk Management and across the company. Our goal is to ensure that a healthy and sustainable liquidity, capital, and interest rate risk (IRR) profile is maintained through baseline economic scenarios, as well as during times of market and idiosyncratic stress.

  
  

**EFR Division: Liquidity Risk Management**

Enterprise Liquidity Risk Management is a department within Enterprise Financial Risk (EFR). This group is responsible for providing an independent assessment of Bank of America’s Liquidity risk, as described within BAC’s Risk Framework. The department’s aim is to support Bank of America’s purpose in making financial lives better through responsible growth. This is accomplished by providing an independent perspective on the effective utilization of Bank of America’s Liquidity resources and ensuring we understand all of the risks that could impact our Liquidity resources. The goal of the department is that a healthy and sustainable Liquidity profile is maintained through a business as usual environment and also during times of stress to support our ability to meet our financial obligations.

**About This Role**
At Chime, we help our members achieve financial peace of mind. To do this we need features that are highly available and human & technical systems that are resilient. That’s where you come in. You will be a member of our Incident Response team to help Chime improve our readiness, response and drive organizational change from incidents.
  
  
As an Incident Operations Manager on Chime's Incident Operations team (Platform Engineering), you'll manage incidents end to end: from declaration and coordination, through member communication and member remediation, to review and follow-through. You'll work across Engineering, Product, Member Experience (MX), Core Experience, Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Finance, and lead through influence rather than authority. You'll bring a proactive, solution-oriented mindset and keep the member at the center of every decision. Alongside on-call work, you'll own defined improvement workstreams that make our response better every quarter.
  
  
**In This Role, You Can Expect To**

* Coordinate incidents end to end. Serve on the incident on-call rotation, including some after-hours coverage on weekends, nights, and holidays. Independently run incidents from declaration to resolution: setting severity, paging the right responders, running the bridge, confirming member impact, and driving mitigation decisions.
* Help drive communication during incidents. Draft clear, accurate member messages across in-app, push, inbox, email, and support channels; move them through Compliance and Legal approval within severity-based timelines; and keep Support and MX teams equipped with talking points.
* Drive member remediation to closure. Run the Remediating phase: define workstreams, DRIs, and exit criteria; partner with Data to size the impacted population; coordinate credits and bulk adjustments with Finance, Compliance, and Core Experience
* Keep stakeholders informed. Deliver timely status reports and sitreps for leadership, and supply impact summaries and timelines that Compliance and Legal use for bank partner and regulatory notifications.
* Close the loop. Facilitate incident reviews for the incidents you manage, capture learnings, and make sure corrective actions have owners and due dates.
* Get ahead of problems. Spot risks and gaps before they become incidents or repeat incidents, raise them early, and come up with a proposed solution.
* Improve how we respond. Own at least one program workstream, such as pre-approved member message templates, runbooks, or response metrics, and ship measurable improvements.
* Cross-train and share knowledge. Build working fluency on both the technical-command and member-impact sides of an incident, and help train coordinators and responders.

* 3+ years in incident management, or a similar operational role, including hands-on coordination of live, customer-impacting incidents.
* A strong member focus. You think first about how an incident affects real people and their money, and you measure success by whether members are informed and made whole, not just whether systems are restored.
* A proactive, solution-oriented approach. You act before being asked, look for the next risk instead of waiting for it, and bring options and recommendations.
* Experience managing the customer side of an incident: writing customer-facing communications, working with support teams, and coordinating remediation.
* Calm, structured judgment under pressure; you know when to decide, when to escalate, and when to ask for help.
* Enough technical fluency to follow engineers through an investigation and ask good questions (observability, deploys, dependencies, distributed systems).
* Experience with incident and observability tools such as PagerDuty, incident.io, Datadog, Slack-based incident tooling, Jira, and Google Workspace.
* Clear, concise writing for different audiences: members, technical SMEs, compliance partners, and executives.
* Strong follow-through; you drive action items and remediation work to closure without being chased.

* Experience in fintech, banking, payments, or another regulated industry.

Position Summary
  
  
The Cloud Service Delivery Manager is responsible for overseeing the delivery, reliability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement of enterprise cloud services across public, private, and hybrid cloud environments. This role serves as the primary liaison between Cloud Operations, Engineering, Architecture, Security, and business stakeholders to ensure cloud platforms meet service level objectives, operational standards, compliance requirements, and business expectations.
  
  
The successful candidate will drive operational governance, incident and problem management, service performance, capacity planning, financial optimization, vendor management, and continuous service improvement while fostering a culture of accountability, automation, resiliency, and customer focus.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Service Delivery & Operations Management
  
  

* Own end-to-end delivery and operational performance of cloud infrastructure and platform services.
* Ensure services meet or exceed defined SLAs, SLOs, availability targets, and customer expectations.
* Lead operational governance reviews and service performance reporting with senior leadership.
* Monitor service health, capacity, utilization, and operational risks across cloud environments.
* Establish and maintain operational runbooks, service documentation, and support processes.

Operational Excellence
  
  

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on stability, automation, resiliency, and operational efficiency.
* Lead root cause analysis efforts and ensure corrective actions are implemented for major incidents.
* Develop and track key operational metrics and KPIs.
* Champion Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and DevOps practices to improve platform reliability.
* Identify opportunities to reduce technical debt and improve service quality.

Incident, Problem & Change Management
  
  

* Serve as the escalation point for major incidents and service disruptions.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams during critical issue resolution activities.
* Lead problem management processes to identify recurring issues and implement permanent fixes.
* Ensure effective change management practices minimize operational risk and service disruption.
* Facilitate post-incident reviews and executive communications.

Stakeholder & Relationship Management
  
  

* Act as the primary interface between Cloud Operations and internal business stakeholders.
* Build strong partnerships with Engineering, Security, Architecture, Risk, Compliance, and Application teams.
* Present service performance, risk assessments, and improvement plans to executive leadership.
* Manage stakeholder expectations and ensure alignment between service delivery and business objectives.

Cloud Governance & Compliance
  
  

* Ensure cloud services operate in accordance with enterprise governance, security, compliance, and regulatory requirements.
* Support audit activities and risk management initiatives.
* Monitor operational controls and remediation activities.
* Drive adherence to cloud operational standards, policies, and best practices.

Financial & Vendor Management
  
  

* Partner with cloud engineering and finance teams to optimize cloud operating costs.
* Monitor cloud consumption trends and support chargeback/showback initiatives.
* Manage relationships with cloud service providers and strategic vendors.
* Participate in contract reviews, service evaluations, and vendor performance assessments.

Team Leadership
  
  

* Lead and mentor cloud operations personnel and service management teams.
* Foster a customer-centric culture focused on accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Support workforce planning, talent development, and succession planning.
* Promote automation-first and cloud-native operational practices.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* 8+ years of experience in IT Operations, Infrastructure Services, Cloud Operations, or Service Delivery.
* 3+ years of leadership experience managing cloud operations, service delivery, or infrastructure teams.
* Strong knowledge of public cloud platforms including Microsoft Azure, AWS, and/or Google Cloud Platform.
* Experience managing enterprise-scale cloud environments in highly regulated organizations.
* Deep understanding of ITIL service management principles and operational processes.
* Experience with incident, problem, change, and release management.
* Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, networking, security, resiliency, and disaster recovery.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams during major incidents and operational events.
* Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and executive presentation skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ITIL Foundation or ITIL Managing Professional Certification.
* Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud certifications.
* Experience with SRE, DevOps, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), and automation platforms.
* Experience supporting financial services, healthcare, or other regulated industries.
* Familiarity with observability platforms such as Datadog, Splunk, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, or Azure Monitor.
* Knowledge of cloud financial management (FinOps) principles.

**Job Description**

The Texas General Land Office is seeking a Manager VII (IT Operations Manager) within the Information Technology Services Department of the agency.

Performs highly advanced managerial work administering the daily operations and activities of the Information Technology Services (ITS) Cloud Operations function. The Cloud Operations Manager leads staff responsible for the agency's cloud, infrastructure, and technology operations and ensures services support GLO programs reliably, securely, and efficiently.

Work involves establishing goals, priorities, guidelines, procedures, and service standards; directing staff performance and development; coordinating daily operations and modernization initiatives; evaluating service performance and operational risk; developing and monitoring budget requests and expenditures; and recommending improvements. The position coordinates with ITS teams, security and governance partners, vendors, and business stakeholders to align services and resources with agency needs.

**Our Mission:**

The Texas General Land Office primarily serves the schoolchildren, veterans, and the environment of Texas. The agency does so by preserving our history, maximizing state revenue through innovative administration, and through the prudent stewardship of state lands and natural resources.

**What Your Contributions to the GLO Will be:**

* People Leadership & Team Management: Directly supervises and supports individual contributors by setting expectations, assigning and prioritizing work, monitoring performance, providing coaching and feedback, and supporting professional development. Builds a cohesive, accountable team environment; addresses performance issues; and ensures staff have the skills, tools, and resources needed to meet operational objectives.
* Operational Execution & Team Delivery: Executes established strategies and plans by coordinating day-to-day team activities, managing priorities and schedules, tracking progress against goals, and resolving operational issues. Ensures work is completed accurately, on time, and in alignment with agency policies, standards, and service expectations.
* Cloud Strategy & Infrastructure Modernization: Leads planning and modernization of the agency's cloud and infrastructure environments. Sets priorities for cloud readiness, migration, platform lifecycle, capacity, and technical debt reduction. Coordinates with technology teams and business stakeholders to align work with agency needs.
* Infrastructure Reliability, Continuity & Disaster Recovery: Oversees the reliability and availability of infrastructure services, including continuity and disaster recovery planning and testing. Directs work to improve backup, recovery, monitoring, capacity, and service resilience, and tracks recovery objectives for critical systems.
* Security, Risk & Compliance: Coordinates with security and governance partners to reduce operational risk and support compliance. Oversees implementation of approved controls for access management, secure configuration, network protection, logging, vulnerability remediation, and audit response across infrastructure services.
* Budget, Procurement & Vendor Oversight: Monitors budgets, procurement, contracts, and vendor performance for CloudOps services. Evaluates resource needs and technology options, monitors expenditures, and recommends investments that support agency priorities and operational efficiency.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in information technology, computer science, information systems, engineering, business administration, or a related field; relevant education and experience may be considered in combination.
* At least eight (8) years of progressively responsible experience in information technology operations, infrastructure, cloud services, systems administration, or a closely related field.
* At least three (3) years of experience supervising or leading technical staff, including assigning work, setting expectations, monitoring performance, and supporting staff development.
* Experience coordinating technology operations or modernization work across teams, assessing service risks, and communicating status and recommendations to leadership and stakeholders.
* Experience supporting infrastructure reliability, security controls, service continuity, or disaster recovery in an enterprise environment.

**Location Requirement:**
This position is based in Austin, TX. Candidates must be currently located in the Austin area or willing to relocate at their own expense. Relocation assistance is not provided.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Ten or more years of progressively responsible experience in IT operations, cloud or infrastructure services, or technology service delivery, including several years in a management role.
* Experience in a state agency, public-sector, or similarly regulated environment, including familiarity with security, audit, procurement, and records requirements.
* Experience with cloud adoption and migration, hybrid infrastructure, identity and access management, enterprise networking, backup and recovery, and monitoring or observability.
* Experience managing operating budgets, service contracts, vendors, and technology lifecycle planning.
* Experience with IT service management, change control, incident response, and service performance measures.

**Physical Requirements:**

This position requires the employee to primarily perform sedentary office work; however, mobility (moving around the worksite) is routinely required to carry out some duties. This position requires extensive computer, telephone and client/ customer contact and communication. It requires the ability to move and position oneself as needed for filing and similar routine office duties. The job also requires normal cognitive abilities requiring the ability to learn, recall, and apply certain practices and policies. It requires the stamina to maintain attention to detail despite interruptions. Ability to read printed materials and computer screens. The individual must be able to move and transport records, documents, boxes, and all related information and materials, weighing up to 20 pounds when required.

* Defined Retirement Benefit Plan Optional 401(k) and 457 accounts
* Medical Insurance - State pays 100% of the health plan premium for eligible full-time employees and 50% of the premium for their eligible dependents. The State pays 50% of the eligible part-time employees' premium and 25% for eligible dependents.

In this strategic leadership role, you will drive the modernization and scalability of enterprise cloud infrastructure, ensuring high-availability architectures and omnichannel capabilities are robust, secure, and aligned with organizational goals. Differentiated from tactical supervisory roles, this position emphasizes broad strategic oversight, multi-cloud enterprise architecture, and advanced technical governance—specifically championing strategic cloud modernization, enterprise-scale FinOps, and multi-cloud architectural roadmap execution to deliver seamless digital services and optimized operational performance.
  
  
**Essential Functions**

* Strategic Vision & Roadmap Execution: Formulate and execute a multi-year cloud operations roadmap supporting OIT's "North Star" objectives, establishing a foundational infrastructure substrate for Colorado’s state-wide digital delivery initiatives.
* Automated Service Delivery & IaC Maturity: Design and implement a self-service provisioning catalog that transitions the team from a "ticket-first" to a "code-first" operational model, driving the adoption of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to ensure 98%+ of infrastructure is deployed via repeatable CI/CD pipelines.
* Policy as Code & Enterprise Governance: Architect and enforce security, accessibility, and compliance guardrails through automated Policy-as-Code (PaC) gates, and represent Platform Services within the Architecture Review Board (ARB) to embed reusable frameworks and "Golden App Templates."
* Multi-Cloud Standardization & Architecture: Define and govern a unified multi-cloud operational posture for Google Cloud that eliminates architectural drift, standardizes security baselines, and simplifies resource management for OIT and agency partners.
* Proactive Observability & Resiliency: Integrate platform telemetry into the enterprise Splunk instance to identify and resolve 90% of service issues proactively, while architecting and exercising robust Disaster Recovery (DR) and resiliency strategies.
* FinOps & Financial Transparency: Develop and implement fully loaded consumption models that provide agencies with clear, real-time visibility into platform costs, enabling data-driven decisions on modernization and utilization.
* Engineering-Led Culture Transformation & Leadership: Drive the organizational shift from a maintenance-focused administrative team to a high-performing product engineering culture, providing leadership in operational governance, financial stewardship, and change management.
* Pod-Aligned Roadmap Execution: Align platform roadmaps directly with the OIT Pod model, ensuring that infrastructure deliverables specifically unblock Digital & Delivery teams and accelerate agency-facing solution deployment
* Actively engage in improving leadership skills, attitudes, and knowledge, especially as related to equity, diversity and inclusion. Attend training, development, and group training on topics of inclusive leadership.

* Monitor write-offs, write-ups, and margin trends.
* Ensure accurate revenue forecasting and backlog reporting.
* Support annual budget planning and quarterly financial reviews.

* Oversee delivery risk management across all active projects.
* Enforce change management and scope control procedures.
* Lead recovery strategies for distressed projects.
* Monitor scope creep and ensure appropriate change order execution.
* Proactively manage decisions to avoid unnecessary high-risk project exposure.

* Balance resources across offices to maximize efficiency.
* Establish clear performance metrics for Engineering Managers.
* Partner with recruiting to ensure operational staffing needs are met.
* Promote accountability and performance discipline within delivery teams.

Process Improvement & Operational Scalability
  
  

* Implement continuous improvement initiatives to increase throughput and consistency.
* Drive adoption of standardized workflows and delivery tools.
* Establish operational performance dashboards tracking schedule, cost, and margin.
* Improve operational systems to support sustainable growth without margin erosion.

Client Relationships & Delivery Oversight
  
  

* Ensure consistent client experience through disciplined delivery.
* Support pricing reviews to confirm alignment between scope, resources, and margin expectations.
* Build and maintain relationships with utility, EPC, and developer clients.
* Manage high-level issue resolution and client escalations.
* Support proposal strategy, fee development, and interview presentations.
* Represent the firm at industry conferences and leadership forums.
* Identify long-term partnership opportunities and cross-selling initiatives.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering.
* Professional Engineer (PE) license.
* 10+ years of experience in utility substation engineering and project delivery.
* Experience managing multi-office engineering teams.
* Demonstrated experience developing utility client relationships.
* Experience with multi-discipline coordination.
* Demonstrated ability to scale teams while maintaining technical quality.
* Ability to balance strategic growth initiatives with operational discipline.
* Willingness to travel to support clients and team locations.

### **Brief Job Description**

The Texas Health and Human Services Commission (HHSC) is seeking qualified candidates for a **Director II – Delivery & Operations** position. This role performs highly complex (senior‑level) managerial work focused on maturing and stabilizing delivery governance by enabling teams to deliver predictably, protecting stakeholders from unnecessary disruption, and reinforcing shared accountability.

The Director II works under minimal supervision with extensive latitude for independent judgment and owns domain‑level intake, prioritization, delivery sequencing, and release readiness decisions across the delivery & operation functions. This position is specifically responsible for standardizing delivery processes across multiple teams, addressing inconsistent intake, discovery, and prioritization practices, and improving predictability and confidence for our stakeholders.

This role practices **servant leadership** by removing obstacles, reinforcing clear governance, and enabling teams and stakeholders to operate with confidence and predictability. This role is intentionally designed to begin as an **enabling leader**, establishing consistent delivery flow, governance discipline, and shared operating practices across teams with differing maturity levels. As delivery flow becomes established and reliable, the role transitions to a more **defensive posture**, protecting stable operations and clean releases while maintaining a continuous‑improvement mindset focused on quality, risk management, and stakeholder trust.

### **Essential Job Functions (EJFs)**

#### **Delivery Governance & Standardization (30%)**

* Owns and enforces a single, standardized intake and delivery governance model that enables teams to focus on delivery while reducing ambiguity and rework.
* Addresses and corrects inconsistent intake, prioritization, and sequencing practices.
* Aligns delivery governance between teams with differing maturity levels, leveraging proven practices where performance is stronger.
* Prevents parallel, exception‑based, or ad‑hoc delivery paths that reduce predictability.

#### **Delivery Flow, Sequencing & Enablement (25%)**

* Establishes predictable delivery flow by clearing obstacles, aligning priorities, and creating conditions for teams to succeed.
* Translates stakeholder priorities into clear, sequenced delivery plans.
* Acts as an enabling leader to help teams adopt disciplined delivery practices.
* Gradually transitions from enablement to protection of established flow once stability is achieved.

#### **Release Readiness & Production Stability (20%)**

* Makes domain‑level release readiness decisions to protect stakeholders, teams, and production environments from avoidable risk and disruption.
* Ensures releases are clean, coordinated, and aligned to operational readiness.
* Protects production stability by balancing delivery commitments with operational risk.
* Reduces rework and late‑stage surprises through disciplined governance.

#### **Stakeholder Confidence & Communication (15%)**

* Builds stakeholder confidence by listening actively, setting clear expectations, and ensuring delivery commitments are realistic, transparent, and honored.
* Improves stakeholder confidence through transparency, predictability, and follow‑through.
* Provides clear communication on intake decisions, sequencing, and delivery status.
* Ensures stakeholders experience a consistent delivery model regardless of team.

#### **Escalation & Risk Management (10%)**

* Serves as the escalation boundary between execution teams and department leadership.
* Resolves domain‑level delivery and operational risks independently when possible.
* Escalates only cross‑domain or high‑risk issues to Director III leadership.
* Reduces unnecessary escalation by strengthening governance and decision clarity.

### **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities (KSAs)**

* Knowledge of delivery governance, intake models, and prioritization in complex environments.
* Knowledge of eligibility systems and operational delivery constraints.
* Skill in removing organizational barriers that impede effective delivery.
* Skill in standardizing processes across teams with varying maturity levels.
* Skill in balancing enablement and enforcement to improve delivery outcomes.
* Ability to lead through **service, trust, and accountability** rather than direct control.
* Ability to balance empathy for teams with responsibility to stakeholders and outcomes.
* Ability to build trust and confidence with program stakeholders.
* Ability to improve delivery flow while protecting operational stability.
* Ability to exercise independent judgment and make sequencing and readiness decisions.
* Ability to lead through governance, clarity, and consistency rather than task management.

### **Initial Screening Criteria**

* Experience leading delivery or operational domains supporting program or eligibility functions.
* Experience improving inconsistent intake, prioritization, or delivery practices.
* Experience standardizing processes across multiple teams.
* Experience working with business or program stakeholders in a service‑delivery environment.
* Experience improving release quality and stakeholder confidence.

### **Registrations, Licensure Requirements, or Certifications**

* Completion of the **AES LEADS Leadership Academy** or similar HHSC leadership development program is preferred, as it supports the leadership, systems‑thinking, and cross‑functional collaboration required for this role.
* IT service management certification (e.g., ITIL 4) – preferred
* Product ownership or portfolio prioritization certification (e.g., CSPO, SAFe POPM) – preferred
* Change management certification (e.g., Prosci) – preferred

As Manager, Service Management & Client Operations, you will support Ark's IT service management (ITSM) processes end to end for a set of assigned clients: Case, Request, Incident, Major Incident, Change, and Problem Management. You will be the main escalation point between assigned clients and our internal support teams.
  
  
You will also help our Service Delivery Center (SDC) take on more. You'll find work the SDC can handle for other teams, set up the hand-off, and make sure the SDC team is trained and ready. You'll work closely with the Director of Client Services and Service Delivery Center Manager as a trusted partner on priorities and initiatives across the client service function.
  
  
What you'll do
  
  
Service management for assigned clients
  
  

* Follow Ark's Case, Request, Incident, Major Incident, Change, and Problem Management processes, policies, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for assigned clients, and give feedback to improve them in line with ITIL best practices.
* Identify and recommend improvements including automation and workflow improvements, to increase efficiency and client satisfaction.
* Support the Major Incident response process for assigned clients from identification through resolution, including coordination, client and internal communication, and post-incident reviews (PIRs) with tracked corrective actions.
* Create, review, and approve change requests for assigned clients, and represent those clients at Change Advisory Board (CAB) meetings, risk and rollback review, scheduling, communication, and change success-rate reporting.
* Own Problem Management for assigned clients. Lead root cause analysis for recurring or high-impact incidents, and maintain problem records, known errors, workarounds, and permanent fixes.

Serve our clients
  
  

* Act as the escalation point between a set of assigned clients and internal teams. Communicate priorities, expectations, and status, and support complex or non-standard requests.
* Monitor queues and escalations for quality and timeliness for assigned clients. Track service level agreement (SLA) performance and raise risks early.
* Report on defined SLAs and service metrics (such as mean time to resolve, backlog, reopen rate, and change success rate) to Ark leadership and clients.

Expand what the SDC can do
  
  

* Analyze ticket trends and workloads for assigned clients to identify tier-1 and tier-2 work the SDC can take on for other teams.
* Serve as a liaison between internal teams and the SDC, setting hand-off criteria, expectations, and escalation paths in partnership with SDC Manager.
* Partner with subject matter experts to build runbooks and knowledge base articles (KBAs), train SDC staff, and confirm readiness before work transitions.
* Measure results after each transition (quality, turnaround time, ticket deflection) and adjust.

Build knowledge and develop people
  
  

* Create and maintain KBAs, runbooks, and client-specific documentation for assigned clients, following Ark’s documentation standards. Coach and mentor future service coordinators.
* Partner with Client Services, Service Delivery Center, Engineering, Product, and Support leadership on process alignment.
* Work with the Director of Client Services on strategy and priorities, lead cross-functional initiatives, and represent the Director with clients and internal leaders as needed.

**Requirements**
What you bring
  
  

* 5+ years in IT service management, service delivery, or IT operations, including at least 2 years in a lead or management role.
* Hands-on ownership of Incident, Major Incident, Change, and Problem Management in a client-facing data center, managed services, or large enterprise environment.
* Experience building SOPs, knowledge base content, and training for support teams.
* Experience with ServiceNow or a similar ITSM platform.
* ITIL 4 Foundation certification, or the ability to earn it within 6 months of hire.
* Strong written and verbal communication, including calm, clear leadership during high-pressure incidents.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to spot trends and turn them into improvements.
* Ability to build relationships and influence across teams without direct authority.

Nice to have
  
  

* Bachelor's degree, or equivalent experience.
* ITIL 4 Managing Professional or higher-level ITIL certification.
* Experience moving work into a shared service or support center.
* Lean or Six Sigma experience.
* SaaS or healthcare IT experience.

Schedule and travel
  
  

* This role leads Major Incident response and requires some after-hours and weekend availability.
* Occasional travel to Ark sites and client locations.

Our clients count on us around the clock, and we know that starts with taking care of our people. Our benefits include:

The Red Hat Hybrid Platforms Product Management team is looking for a Principal Product Manager (technical) to own and drive identity solutions in Red Hat OpenShift.

In this role, you are responsible for how people, workloads, and software agents authenticate to OpenShift and how OpenShift decides what they are allowed to do. You will work with the Engineering and Product teams who build and deliver those capabilities. The product area includes:

* User authentication and authorization, including the OpenShift OAuth server and external OpenID Connect integrations, Kubernetes RBAC, workload identity, multi-cluster authentication on OpenShift clusters
* Identity and user federation to secure agentic workflows in OpenShift.

You will plan and deliver product content for new releases and launches, prioritize and communicate requirements to guide development, support the field in advanced sales opportunities, perform competitive reviews, and work with partners. You will contribute to company strategy and work closely with Engineering, Marketing, Support, Sales, Security, and Field teams.

You will engage with the open source communities behind this work, including Kubernetes and other Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF) projects.

As a Principal Product Manager, you need great communication, teamwork, and persuasion skills to articulate the product vision, align teams across the company, and influence stakeholders. This is an opportunity to work on a core platform control alongside some of the brightest minds in open source.

**What you will do:**
---------------------

* Collect input from OpenShift users, customers, community members, and internal stakeholders on how enterprises manage identity, and turn that input into strategy and a roadmap
* Define the product vision, the customer problems to solve, and measurable outcomes for authentication, authorization, and workload identity.
* Define and use metrics for adoption and measuring success
* Research commercial and do-it-yourself alternatives and use that research for competitive positioning
* Prioritize and document requirements, epics, and user stories, with acceptance criteria, for new releases
* Guide major enhancements with OpenShift Engineering, Kubernetes upstream, and adjacent product teams.
* Drive the identity model that agentic features in OpenShift and related products use, and work with those product teams so agents obtain authority through OpenShift identity and authorization
* Work with Sales on customer inquiries, presentations, and demos.
* Support go-to-market work, including presentations, blogs, demos, workshops, events, and sales enablement, and review documentation for this area
* Keep Engineering, Support, and Field aligned on direction, and own the translation of strategy into a release plan

**What you will bring:**
------------------------

* 5+ years of enterprise software experience in product management, technical marketing, solutions engineering, or a similar technical product or customer-facing role
* A track record of leading cross-functional work on a platform, security, or identity management, and of influencing people who do not report to you
* Direct experience with Kubernetes identity management.
* Working knowledge of OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect, and or how enterprises use identity provider (e.g. Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Ping Federate).
* Working knowledge of cloud workload identity. Depth in at least one of the following, and literacy in the others: AWS STS, Microsoft Entra workload identity, and Google Workload Identity or Workload Identity Federation
* A clear view of how a typical enterprise uses identity: single sign-on, group-based access, joiner-mover-leaver, non-human identities, and short-lived credentials as the default
* A clear view of how identity should work for agentic AI.
* Linux skills and direct experience with Linux containers and Kubernetes
* Working knowledge of the CNCF ecosystem and experience with open source projects
* Demonstrated ability to listen to customers, stakeholders, and engineering and turn that into product decisions
* Ability to handle several competing priorities
* Bachelor's or graduate degree in computer science, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience
* Excellent written and verbal communication
* Willingness to travel up to 25%

**The following are considered a plus:**
----------------------------------------

* Hands-on configuration of OpenShift identity providers, OAuth, external OpenID Connect, or cloud credential modes used by managed OpenShift
* Upstream participation in Kubernetes SIG Auth or a related CNCF project
* Experience with SPIFFE and SPIRE, LDAP, or Active Directory
* Understanding of zero trust principles.
* Experience with compliance programs in which identity is a control, such as FedRAMP or PCI
* Prior experience with agile delivery and with Jira or a similar tool
* A track record of enterprise product launches

* Communicate how specific Red Hat cloud solutions and our cloud roadmap align to customer use cases
* Travel occasionally to visit regional customers

**What You Will Bring**

* 5+ years of experience working in a support, development, engineering, IT, or a quality assurance organization
* Administration experience with Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) cloud solutions like Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform
* Expertise in enterprise cloud solutions like Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS), containers, Kubernetes, cloud management, and IT automation
* Ability to manage and grow existing enterprise customer relationships by delivering proactive, relationship-based support
* Competent comprehension of enterprise architecture and strategic business drivers
* Ability to manage multiple issues and projects with shifting priorities and timelines
* Outstanding written and verbal communication skills and ability to convey complex information to customers clearly and concisely in English
* Ability to travel for customer visits and events within the region
* Bachelor's degree or an equivalent in a technology-related discipline, ideally computer science or engineering is a plus
* Good comprehension of continuous integration (CI) and continuous delivery (CD) concepts a plus
* Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE) a plus

This role within the Deal Velocity organization is responsible for providing Tier I and Tier II operational support to regional Pricing & Contract Management (PCM) analysts and management. Key responsibilities include assisting PCM teams in creating special pricing solutions, resolving issues for complex pricing and contract term requests, as well as representing the PCM organization on special projects to ensure alignment with corporate objectives.
  
  
Policy & Strategic Governance
  
  

* Develop and execute global policies for PCM analysts based on new pricing, product changes, promotions, and financial guidelines.
* Represent the PCM organization throughout the wireline product launch process and on cross-functional process teams to ensure PCM impact and alignment are prioritized.
* Engage frequently with cross-functional teams across marketing, legal, finance, regulatory, and operations.

Support & Operational Excellence
  
  

* Manage the PCM analyst support ticket queue to ensure timely IT resolution of user-impacting issues.
* Address daily issues identified by the PCM user community related to assigned initiatives.
* Drive ticket volume reduction through proactive user education and system enhancements.
* Provide input on complex deals by collaborating with PCM on deal strategy.
* Assist in resolving pricing-related billing issues.

Systems, Requirements, & UAT Testing
  
  

* Represent the pricing tower associated with the platform used for quoting, ordering, contracting, and invoicing in identifying and implementing strategic initiatives, including developing business requirements that drive work efficiencies for cross-functional end users and the PCM analyst community.
* Collaborate independently with product, IT, pricing, and finance stakeholders to ensure decisions positively impact PCM workflows.
* Design rigorous, thorough test cases and perform user acceptance testing to ensure quote-to-order systems and new capabilities provide a seamless end-user experience.

Tools & Custom Rate Development
  
  

* Create and maintain product-specific profitability models and efficiency tools for the PCM organization.
* Serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in specific product areas to support marketing and pricing on the development of new rates, pricing floors, and promotions, ensuring full compliance with corporate strategy and regulations.
* Training, Communication, & Knowledge Management
* Develop and deliver global PCM training sessions, communications, and enablement materials for new products, tools, and key pricing program initiatives.
* Design content for the monthly PCM Newsletter and maintain the PCM ServiceNow knowledge base.

What we're looking for...
  
  
**You’ll Need To Have**

* Bachelor's degree or four or more years of work experience.
* Six or more yeras of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training.
* Six or more years of experience managing special pricing arrangements and custom customer agreements.
* Deep understanding of standard Wireline products, custom product pricing, and Verizon's deal lifecycle from presale through invoicing.
* Proficiency in profit & loss modeling, cash flow analysis, and financial analysis, with experience writing and reviewing business requirements for pricing, billing, and contracting tools.
* Proficiency in Google Workspace and Microsoft Office. Hands-on experience with ServiceNow.

Even better if you have one or more of the following:
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or equivalent experience.
* Proven ability to make sound business decisions quickly under pressure, with a focus on quality improvement and process efficiency.
* Exceptional organizational, communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills with strong relationship management abilities.

* Joint GTM Strategy Orchestration: Co-lead the commercial operating cadence between Segment Strategy and GTM Operations, ensuring cross-functional handoffs between strategic insights, enablement rollout, and sales floor execution are seamless and measurable.

Executive Data Analysis, AI, & Predictive Reporting (15%)

* Transition fragmented, manual spreadsheets into unified, live executive dashboards (Airtable / Looker) that serve as the single source of truth for the ELT.

* Produce concise, qualitative executive narratives that explain why metrics are moving and define the specific operational actions required to accelerate performance.

* Act as a trusted strategic advisor to senior leadership by providing financial framing for accelerate/pause/stop decisions on portfolio programs and GTM bets.

**Job Overview**
The Technology Solutions Manager designs, builds, and delivers digital solutions that support Operational Resiliency initiatives and advance digital-first problem solving. This role leads solution discovery, requirements definition, and technical feasibility assessments, translating business needs into practical, scalable, and sustainable solutions that improve operational efficiency, visibility, and responsiveness.
  
  
Combining solution design with hands-on technical execution, this role drives the development and implementation of digital solutions, workflow automation, system integrations, and operational dashboards using modern data platforms, AI, and low-code technologies. The Technology Solutions Manager collaborates across business and technology teams, contributes to solution architecture decisions, and owns delivery outcomes while identifying opportunities to simplify processes and improve existing capabilities.
  
  
Success is measured by delivering effective digital solutions, turning real-time data into faster operational decisions, reducing manual effort, and measuring the impact of those solutions on event outcomes and recovery.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**
:
  
  

* Solution Delivery

+ Manage inception activities, including breaking down business requirements and defining technical scope
+ Partner with leaders to define technology strategy for operational resiliency initiatives and recommend scope and delivery plans
+ Serve as technical lead across business, AI, automation, and development initiatives
+ Lead delivery of digital AI and automation solutions within operational resiliency, providing leadership in analysis, design, and project and product management
+ Design and deliver real-time intelligence solutions, such as automated data feeds and AI-driven alerting, that inform decisions during critical events
+ Assess and resolve technical solution escalations

* Strategy

+ Partner with business and technology teams to define goals, priorities, approach, and roadmaps
+ Prepare high-level solution design and technical documentation for business leadership
+ Serve as subject matter expert on operational intelligence platforms and recommend how to elevate and integrate them
+ Define measures to evaluate how team actions and information influence event outcomes and recovery time

* Relationship and Change Management

+ Manage day-to-day stakeholder relationships on cross-domain initiatives
+ Provide leadership in evolving design and solution integration across domain teams
+ Summarize and communicate complex information, applying critical thought to drive meaningful insights and decisions

* Special Initiatives

+ Support special initiatives and high-priority projects as needed
+ Participate in on-call rotation and deployment support for natural disasters and high-priority events
